reviews.text:
Google Maps takes you to a Coply Place entrance. You can take the escalator up to the Yard House. The Yard House Restaurant is very big. I was seated right away even though they were busy.
I ordered the Shitake Garlic 🧄 Noodles 🍜 as an appetizer and the amount 🍽️ was huge! I had the Everything Crusted Ahi Sandwich with fries. The sandwich was messy but it did taste good 👍! My mocktail was a Mule'ish creation that was one of their alcoholic drinks but with a dragon fruit (?) syrup substitute. They did not have what I wanted so they created a mocktail and charged me the price of a ginger beer 🍺, which was $4.
I thought 🤔💬 the prices were reasonable for Boston. Service was good 👍!
It was very loud 🔊 in there. It seems that the louder the music 🎶 people have to raise their voices so people can hear 🙉 each other in conversations.
I recommend this restaurant but if you want more quiet 🤫 dining, you may want to check ✔️ first 🥇 with how busy the restaurant is. I went on a Saturday evening 🌆 so it was busy!

Yard House was conveniently located in the Copley Marriott on the 2nd floor. After arriving to Boston late in the evening we got a late night meal. We only had about a 10 minute wait for a table which was great considering the host told us it was a 3 hour wait all day long as this was the end point for the Boston Marathon. It made it really neat to be able to see alot of the runners here at the finish place. My friend & I both ended up ordering the Korean BBQ steak and subbing the fries for mashed potatoes. We started with cheese curds & wings, both were mediocre. Cheese curds were good but were a bit on the soggy side - I am also a bit spoiled as the ones we serve back home are garlic crusted so these lacked in flavor in comparison. We got two types of wings - buffalo & sweet chili. The sweet chili ones were better than the regular buffalo wings, nothing too special about these. The flavor on the steak was delicious and the potatoes were top notch. I highly recommend those mashed potatoes  they were the best part of the meal. We were glad the restaurant is open late and had a wide variety of items.

We had a great experience at Yard House in Boston! We came to enjoy the World Cup atmosphere, and it was a fun place to watch the game. The wait after ordering was longer than expected, and they were even out of some beers (they jokingly blamed it on all the soccer fans 😂), but the staff handled everything well.
The happy hour deals were fantastic, and overall the food, atmosphere, and experience made it a memorable visit. Definitely a great spot to catch a game with friends!

Thank you Sergio . The service was outstanding . Amazing food amazing service. Always consistently perfect. We got our usual which is the whiskey aged burger and the steak bowl absolutely superb, perfect temperature and portion and taste out of this world as always.

Another impromptu meal stop that really.paid off. Lots of TV's with different sports. Large seating area with music that added to the vibe but didn't make it hard to converse. They do have a tabletop electronic menu device so you can see what you are ordering. They have an extensive beer menu but also some GF ciders and seltzer. They wait staff was very helpful and attentive. I had the cilantro lime chicken and the chicken was tender enough to cut with my fork.

Being from a small town large buildings make my knees and the earth below shake. My Host Birdi was kind, comforting, and lightning fast! One look was all it took to cool my nerves. To top it off, my server Alyson recommended a yard beer of the cloud candy!! What a wonderful brew. Her knowledge of the menu, effervescence and all around good nature! I was made to feel right at home!

I ordered a Whiskey Glazed hamburguer, it was one of the best hamburgers I have ever tried, simply amazing. The place is very nice, the service was excellent, the beer menu is out of this world! Too many options! I definitely recommend and I will be back for sure!

I added this restaurant to my lunch list near tourist attractions, and I was pleasantly surprised by the portion size ,the nachos were absolutely huge! I had to take some home. Both the burger and the nachos were delicious. The staff were very attentive and checked in to make sure I was satisfied with my meal. Everything about this experience was wonderful. I’ll definitely come back if I have the chance.

Food was delicious as always. Service was a bit slow Due to being marathon weekend but we had a good
Time. The chicken nachos were amazing! Dinner servings a bit small but food was prepared to order. Large variety of beer selection. My son was able to enjoy a basketball game he wanted to watch while eating. Was able to pay bill on computer tablet, this was nice because we were able to pay and get out quicker.

Good bar restaurant. The tacos were amazing, particularly the shrimp and steak. Kiara did a great job as a waitress by focusing on the menu items she thought the customer wanted most, not just the most expensive items on the menu. She was quick and effective. The next day I ate the ribeye steak and it isn’t a steakhouse dry-aged wagyu but the quality was satisfyingly above average.

I went to Yard House with my friends for a nice evening. We ate food and watched some football.

It's usually pretty crowded, but if you go on Monday through Friday from 3pm to 6pm, you'll find they offer happy hour prices, which cover a lot of their dishes.

I'm not gonna lie, the food is okay, but sometimes it just doesn't feel cooked properly.

Other than that, a good place to hangout.

First, the music was too loud, unless you enjoy yelling across the table to your company. The next day at 3 pm there was a wait even though the restaurant was only 25% full, due to staffing. Food is mediocre, and for that you're going to pay a relatively high price. There are too many other good restaurants within walking distance to justify eating here.
The mushroom pizza and loaded tacos were delicious. They have some really interesting drinks options and loads of beer varieties.

Stopped in for a few drinks while at Copley Place. We didn't eat, so I can’t comment on the food, but the atmosphere was great. It took a bit to get served since there was only one bartender working the bar at the time. My husband got an IPA flight, which came with a handy info paper explaining each selection. Note that everything is strictly draft beer here—no bottled options!

Happy Hour runs from 3–6 PM and offers a variety of tasty appetizers, though service was slow despite the lack of a crowd. The queso was thick and cheesy with a subtle kick from the hot sauce. The chicken nachos were a standout, with a huge portion loaded with toppings and flavor.

The lettuce wraps featured crisp butter lettuce with sweet and savory dipping sauces, while the classic sliders were delicious alongside fries. The thin-crust carnivore pizza was hearty and loaded with smoky meats.

We are staying at the Marriott Copley place for our honeymoon this week. We went Monday evening with a reservation and today(Thanksgiving). The food was good both nights but the service was less than good. We waited 20 minutes to have drinks refilled, when we just asked for them to go instead. When we asked for our to go drinks and a box, our waitress came back and asked if we had talked to the manager about our missing happy hour appetizer that we also never received. No…? She was like oh well your check isn’t showing up so she had to go ring us back in. I understand today is a holiday and it was busy,  but 2 evenings in a week of similar service from 2 different waitresses….this will be a no for us to dine in again, perhaps to go would be better. As you can see in the photos the food both nights was delicious and the new orange yardsicle was a hit for me.

Yard House is always a must for me when traveling! I've been to the Waikiki and Las Vegas locations, both of which were excellent! The beer selection is huge, and I love that they have so many local beers! I went with a delicious local beer which had loads of blueberries in it, it tasted great! I absolutely love the poke nachos, and their fish & shrimp tacos are my absolutely favorite tacos that I have ever had anywhere! Making them vampire style is a must! I shared my love of YH tacos with the manager who provided me with a free taco! My friend ordered the fish & chips, which were delicious too!

Our server was Myles, and he was absolutely fantastic! Myles was so friendly and energetic! I ordered a dessert, and Myles went out of his way to do something special when he found out that I ran the Boston Marathon! The dessert was such a wow moment! Myles made this an unforgettable experience!

YH will continue to be a must stop for me on my travels and will be returning to this location too when in Bosotn next!

Yard House Boston is one of my favorite spots for craft beer and a lively atmosphere. The moment I walked in, I was greeted by friendly staff and a vibrant setting with big TVs perfect for sports fans. I ordered the Korean BBQ Tacos and the Crispy Chicken Sliders—both were packed with flavor and well-seasoned. Their extensive beer list is impressive, especially the local craft brews. I appreciated the fast service despite the busy crowd, and the patio seating was perfect for a sunny afternoon. Prices are reasonable considering the portion sizes and quality. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a casual, fun night out with friends or to watch the game!

We love the Yard House where we live we go every week, when we travel is tradition we find one in the area. The service was not great at the bar, appetizer we ordered took forever. Still good food but not a good day of service.

We stumbled upon the Yard House accidentally on our last trip to Boston. It was so great I went out of my way to get there on this visit... Twice!
I would consider the food to be elevated pub style. The menu has some Asian fusion items that were nicely done. In my 3 visits, the food has been served prompt, hot and fresh. The mixed drinks are good and they have a great beer selection. Servers and bartenders have been super friendly and attentive. This is a must stop on every Boston trip for me !
Food was very good. Menu diverse and prices reasonable. Server was not intrusive, helpful and present just enough. My husband and I had a nice quiet corner to ourself. It was a perfect date!

April 2024:
Stayed at the Marriott hotel for five nights and stopped by the Yard House for beer 🍻 and dinner a few times.

Beer selection was very good. Had a lot of decent standards plus a small selection of local beer 🍻.

Food wise, I had the ahi salad one night and the bacon burger another night. Both were tasty. The salad was a bit over dressed. I would ask for the salad dressing on the side next time.

The burger was delicious. Would get it again if I was craving a good burger.

Service was friendly and fast. They were very busy every time I stopped by.

We came in for dinner since we were staying at the Marriott. This was before the dinner rush and we got sat down right away. The service was quick, friendly, and attentive throughout dinner.

The place was huge with plenty of space, tables, and large televisions. Many people were watching sports. We got the firecracker shrimp; tempura shrimp, sweet soy ginger, red pepper threads, green onions, cilantro, sweet chili siracha on crispy rice cake. OMG- this appetizer alone was five stars for me. Then I had the Nashville Hot Chicken sandwich with fries; it has white cheddar, spicy sweet slaw, garlic aioli on toasted brioche bun. The sandwich flavor was on point and perfectly crispy and the fries were crunchy.

They got really busy when we're were starting to leave. The check took a while to come after we were done. It's okay, we understand why since our waitress had a huge party come through. I was able to walk my infant and toddler around the hotel lobby. Other than that, overall a good a experience!

We went to sit down to have dinner around 5:30 on a Thursday night. My father is hard of hearing and we were sat directly under a speaker. We asked if we could please be moved to another table. There was a slightly quieter dining room open, however, we were told by the hostess that we could be moved to another booth however “this is a sports bar so there’s going to be music blaring everywhere.” She was very condescending. We decided to leave and try somewhere else. I did not appreciate her attitude.

So on a whim, at 6 PM on a Friday night my family walked into the Yard House and were pleasantly surprised! Even though it was packed, the hostess got us seated right away, and our server greeted us directly and got us drinks. After a few minutes to decide and a few cocktails we ordered, and in spite of the place being jampacked, we got our food in a timely manner, and it was fantastic! We’re couldn’t have been happier! Prompt service, delicious food, stiff cocktails and a great atmosphere made this a perfect night. We’ll definitely be back!!! Sorry for the pictures of food that’s been partially eaten, but we were so hungry. I forgot to take pictures before I started! The garlic, beef and noodles was amazing, my daughter’s salmon was perfect and my wife said her Philly cheesesteak sandwich was the best she’d ever had!

We had dinner here tonight and it was a great experience from start to finish. The food was excellent. What really stood out though was our server. Tian was fantastic. Great service can really make a meal, and he definitely did. We'll be back and would recommend this place to anyone looking for a really good meal and a great overall experience.

I’ll be honest, I wasn’t sure what to expect. Every time I’ve gone, I’ve had a great meal. Excellent food for a sports bar. My favorites so far are the poke nachos, cali roll stack, whiskey aged burger, pork chop meal with cauliflower rice and Korean cheesesteak. The onion rings were really good too! I usually get mocktails when I go, and those have been solid as well depending on the bartender! I don't have all the photos but I added some. Trying to think of what I'll try next 🤔

Service varies depending on the server. It's cool but sometimes you ask for things like water and they forget etc...

Great food and great service. I had the blackened chicken bowl, which was flavorful and cooked perfectly. The Brussels sprouts were excellent, and the spinach dip was delicious. The hostess was very nice, and our server was helpful and friendly. Definitely a place I'll return to. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We really enjoyed ourselves here The food was good The drinks were Terrific 💯 The music was love,!!! Rock and 80's music is great for me. They had 1000 draft beer flavors from where I was sitting...

My daughter & I went to watch the England & France soccer game ... food was really good. She had guacamole w/chips, traditional wings with lemon pepper, and I had the Shitake Garlic Noodles & a side of the Parm Truffle fries ... I tried the Tokyo Yuzu Sake Gimlet & I am in love it was so smooth & refreshing ... it's tart & my daughter said it was too sour but I thought it was perfect ... I even looked for the recipe & ordered the ingredients to make it at home!!!

Ana our server was so nice ! My first ever at yard house and it was delicious! Definitely will be back !  The chicken tortilla soup was so good ! The pasta and tacos yummy. The Oreo brookie good flavors.

I came here for the first time with my family. Our waitress Karlee was amazing and super nice to us. She made us feel very comfortable and welcome in this establishment. Same with our secondary waiter Cole (Karlee’s shift ended). The food was delicious. I got myself some carne asada tacos and they were fabulous. The vibes I got from this place were amazing and really boosted my mood up today. Overall a fantastic restaurant and we will be returning soon! 🔥

The food was absolutely AMAZING! We ordered a poke bowl, chicken nachos, burgers, kids’ burgers, and fries — and everything was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly made. You can really tell they care about the quality of their food.
The only downside was the service. When I asked for hot water, it was served to me in a PLASTIC cup, which was surprising and honestly a bit disappointing. Otherwise, great food and overall a place worth visiting if the service improves a bit!

Now awesome place BUT if you’re going please expect to leave with high blood pressure😭😭my server was nice but when I tell you EVERYTHING WAS SALTY. If you zoom in on the picture with the chips you ca actually see how much salt was added to each chip. I got the barbecue burger or something like that to go because I literally felt like my blood vessels were about to burst open. Idk if the chef was going through a breakup or something I don’t really know but Damm brother!. Great ambience though🩷my server was definitely not salty she was awesome🩷

Dinner was delicious and the lobster shrimp possum the taste is delicious. It’s creamy it’s flavorful. It’s really really good. My mom and Brother got the steak. They didn’t like the sauce the steak sauce with it, but it was pretty good. My dad got these tacos. I don’t know what he said about it, but they were good then we got dessert, we got the Oreo brookie, It was overcooked but good., then we got the bread pudding and that was actually pretty good. It was like a soft texture a little chewy but soft. Almost forgot we got the two appetizers the cheesy things they were good. The sauce was spicy though then we got the fried Carey, they were OK.

My review is to give the highest praise ever to the staff here, especially to server Charnnae who was the highlight of our experience. She was so warm and kind, and handled our food needs (quite a few swaps and substitutions) with grace and kindness. We'll come back because of her! :) Thank you, Char!

This was my first visit to Yard House at the Willow Grove Mall in Philadelphia, and it definitely won’t be my last! I came from New Jersey with my daughter to visit a friend, and we decided to stop in for lunch. Our server, Chrissy, was absolutely amazing — personable, kind, efficient, and her recommendations were spot on!

She even took the time to snap a few photos for us and chat like we were old friends, all while effortlessly tending to her other tables. I visit a lot of restaurants, and I always pay close attention to customer service because it means everything in my own business — and Chrissy’s was outstanding!

We truly enjoyed the appetizers, drinks, and entrées (the pork chops are a must-try!). The next time I’m in the area, I’ll definitely be requesting Chrissy again if she’s still there. She has exceptional people skills and made our visit a great experience from start to finish. Thank you, Chrissy, for making our day so enjoyable!

I came here about 9 pm this Saturday and we asked for a booth inside and was sat outside in the mall area and it was hot as ever. We asked a server to reseat us inside, and we were accommodated. We ordered the pole nachos and two shiitake garlic mushroom noodles. Usually, the noodles are fantastic and flavourful. This time, they were nasty, dry and not flavourful at all. We weren’t charged for them. We ordered fish & chips, and two of the spicy jumbalaya. The jumbalaya was nasty and not seasoned. The fish & chips were just ok. We asked to purchase a half yard glass and was ignored by the server who kept using the fact that they were busy as an excuse to take forever when it came to purchasing one. We just paid our tab and tipped the server. I doubt I come back to this location. They’re getting lazy with cooking and service.

Came here to celebrate an anniversary and the beginning of a new year and it was my and my boyfriends most favorite spot. Our waitress Ana was the sweetest and whatever she is getting paid should be raised. All the food has pictures on the menu which was very helpful. Their appetizers alone are to die for but everything was such good quality and delicious. So many different options for different cravings. In the end we wanted to get dessert and were suprised when the waitress brought us a free one even before we ordered it. It was just a perfect experience. Ana was amazing! Will be back here many times!!

I walked in on a Friday night and was immediately impressed with the customer service—every time I looked up, someone was ready to help, and I noticed they were attentive to other guests too. I ordered the spicy jambalaya, which was really good! Just a heads-up: the spice level was more of a 5 out of 10, so if you like it extra hot like I do, you might want to ask for more heat. I also tried the crispy Brussels sprouts, and the aioli dip that came with them was amazing! Overall, I’d definitely recommend this spot—among food chains, it’s one of the better options.

This is my favorite go to ‘chain restaurant’ spot for lunch and dinner. This location never disappoints. I brought my good friend here and she loved everything offered.
The food is so delicious. I appreciate their willingness to substitute and accommodate done food. Instead of brown rice I got cauliflower rice in my dish.
Their wings, which I always ask for lemon pepper, dry rub, or delicious. Poke nachos were so good. And my friend just loved her steak noodles.
Another place with great consistency in their food and service. I truly do appreciate it!
Thank you Yard House!

My family had a great experience at your restaurant today. My Father passed away on 3/2/26 and this was the first time my Mother left the house. My parents wedding anniversary was 3/14/26 so going out to eat today was a big deal. (There was 14 of us.) Elda was our waitress. She was amazing. She did not know about  our families loss. Elda was friendly, kind, and attentive.  It was a pleasure having her as our waitress. Her smile and kindness really made a difficult day a little easier.
I would like to add that the food was delicious and the portions were very generous.
Thank you for a great experience.
I should add that we had a wheelchair, a walker, a highchair, and a stroller, and had no troubles with our seating accommodations.

half of this one drink made me really sick. me & my friend had to throwup, stomach & chest hurting. I dont know what was used in the drinks but it was horrible. This never happened to us before. I actually love yardhouse, but i never want to experience that feeling again.

I come here often, but took the day off to spend the day with the wifey. Ended up at a fam favorite for some kidless happy hour fun. After the week she had I was happy to give her a chance to getaway and have a great meal on the low.

What started out as a really good experience turned sour towards the end.

When we first arrived everything was going well, we told the server about allergies and dietary restrictions. We ordered 4 of the vegan wing options, the Brussel sprouts and a few other items for the kids. Everything was really delicious until the main course came out. I ordered a classic veggie burger. The food came out and I took a bite. Instantly hit my stomach like a ton of bricks. I have been a vegetarian for over 20 years due to my Crohn’s Disease. Meat makes me very ill. I knew it was wrong after that initial bite and called the server over who then told me it was a classic beef burger and not the veggie burger. There was some mix up or miscommunication. I know it was not malicious, and the kid was very nice the whole night, generally was a good server, but that mistake had me in the Yard House bathroom throwing up for 20 minutes. Stomach has felt off ever since. So unfortunately the experience ended up being bad for us.

My first time at the yard house and I’ll be back! It seemed a little busy but a table for two was a quick 10-15 mins. Our waitress was very nice and had a good flow of service. She checked on us just enough and our drinks and food came out in good timing.
I had an old fashioned which was balanced well. We had the Brussels sprouts, shrimp app, and spicy beef noodles. Everything tasted great and we will definitely be back and I can’t wait to come for football season!

Seated very quickly, service was quick and fast. The waiter Josh was great making our first time here enjoyable. The food came out fast and all was good. The atmosphere is sport bar and family friendly. Highly recommend the poke nachos as an appetizer.

Yard House remains one of my absolute go-to spots, and this recent visit reminded me why. From the moment we walked in, the customer service was on point—fast, friendly, and they kept the drinks refilled without us even having to ask.
The food, as always, was the star of the show. The California Roll Stack is easily one of the best appetizers on the menu; the flavors are so fresh and it’s perfectly balanced with the ginger and wasabi. For the main course, I went with the Cheesesteak, and it was supreme. The steak was tender, the peppers and onions were grilled just right, and the melted cheese pull was top-tier.
Whether you're looking for a solid spot for a date or just a reliable meal with a great atmosphere, Yard House delivers every time. I'll definitely be back for that stack soon!

Haven’t been to this location in a couple of years and decided to give it a try again.  Truly had  high hopes because the aromas that fill the air are quite enticing to bring you in.  Was seated immediately in a booth. Location was quite busy.  Drink order was taken then a reasonable amount of time ordered an appetizer and our two entrées.  We got the queso dip with the upgrade of the spicy ground beef.  It had a decent taste, but was not spicy.  I liked that it came with soft tortillas and crunchy.    I tried the Carne Asada tacos with spicy rice and my husband got the Hawaiian chicken.   The tacos looked good when they came out they had a spicy Verde sauce.  However the meat had absolutely no flavor which was surprising   The green sauce had no spice to it whatsoever. Very disappointing.   The Hawaiian chicken was a nice sweet flavor. It was served with a plain white rice.  The broccolini ? I assume that’s what it was, did not have a good flavor.  Overall, a very lackluster dinner.  The service was good. The atmosphere was fine. Busy and loud.   Not offensive.   The food was the letdown.   Overall, what we ordered was nothing special.  With so many options these days we probably won’t return to try a different menu items.

LOOOOOVED our experience here!! From Management, servers, even the kitchen everyone deserves there flowers! We had our gender reveal in the patio area Saturday. Normally they do not take big reservations for the weekends however after expressing this was the best time we could get our family together who all traveled about an hour (best place for everyone to meet in the middle) to come and celebrate with us the managers David and Ron we nothing but accommodating and understanding! We ordered platters and appetizers for our guests and the food was AMAZING!!! Chicken avocado sandwiches were my personal favorite. Our servers Melissa and Kaiden were on top of everything keeping everyone’s glass full, having great energy and clearing plates from the tables. 10/10 and thank you everyone for taking care of our family. We had the best time and will definitely be coming back very soon.

In from out of town and we arrived about 5:30 pm and took around 25 mins to get a table. Service was good. Beer was good. Meal was good. The atmosphere was excellent. Our waitress Casey server was excellent and got me a dessert for my birthday. Recommend this venue for a good time and a good meal. Huge tap beer variety.

We came here for the first time about 3 years ago looking for new places to try and we fell in love with everything. We come here at least 5-7 times a year and every time is the same beautiful experience. From the waitress, atmosphere, the drinks even the manager. Very friendly and they care about your experience. We love recommending YardHouse.
Highly recommend go as soon as the open, Appetizers CHICKEN NACHOS with everything (it will fill you so make sure you order something light), the BBQ salad and the chicken wings are crunchy and a good size also the guava cider.

I’d say this place was great better than a previous experience I had. My server was amazing considering that it was near closing time like 10:45 ish when I arrived. Food was pretty good despite having to wait that’s my own perk about it. The wait time for the food was over 30+ mins which was a bummer but only so much one person can do. The music makes it hard to have a decent conversation without screaming but you can still socialize. Overall, excellent service and restaurant would go again!

Early evening dinner.
Staff was super friendly and attentive.
Ordered chicken fettuccine. I was ok. Salt and pepper did the trick. Also Ordered tuna ahi sandwich. It was OK, because I was hungry. Wouldn't order it again. Sweet potato fries were hot.

Went twice in the same week, during the week that Monday (Happy Hour) our server Lex was great, food came out periodically which was fine because we ordered a lot.

Tried the lobster garlic noodles for the first time and I see why they are a crowd favorite! Pizzas were fine nothing too exciting, however I think the buffalo chicken pizza was the best and it was hot(spicy) I should’ve gotten some ranch, it was a little dry. the chicken bites were suppose to have a whiskey glaze… very dry & had to ask for more. The grilled salmon was good as pictured below the asparagus was very sad looking, hard & cold to touch. When asked for other asparagus to be prepared, they obliged kindly. That type of four cheese spinach may have to be a personal preference, I didn’t enjoy it & I love spinach dip.

- Went Sunday Tracey was our waitress, she was fine but I had to keep asking for stuff again after already asking during the initial  ordering.. example we shared an app and knew we’d need more than one sauce & ordered that, by the time my second sauce was brought I was nearly finished. I assume the ceaser salad is not made to order bc it was cold and mushy as if it was sitting in a fridge.
The Korean BbQ Steak for it to be made medium it was one of the toughest cuts of steak I’ve ever eaten and the lobster garlic noodles were not as good as earlier in the week. Asked for extra sauce during that initial ordering as well… it came much later during the meal…

The midnight sangria drink was better than the dragonfruit margarita and the smoky old fashioned smelled good but was just ehh in taste.

Place can get busy depending on the time you go! The bar area has multiple tvs so if you want to watch a game or many & catch a quick app/drink I would recommend. Cute date night place.

The best execution of a firecracker shrimp ever ! The bed of sweet crispy rice is amazing,  has the perfect amount of sweet chewy and crispy,  just amazing.  Firecracker shrimp always just has potential but not here they nail it !

It's a pretty standard sports bar fare.
The place is clean and service is good. Food came out fairly quick.
The chicken nachos was huge serving, just like in many other sports bars.
I love the fact that they have leaner options that keeps the calorie count reasonable.

I recently came to the Yard House with a large group to celebrate both a birthday and a military-related event, and the experience was absolutely amazing. The staff truly went above and beyond to make the night special.

Nick in particular put in an incredible amount of effort. He decorated our table with balloons and beautiful decorations that were both birthday-themed and military-themed. It was such a thoughtful touch and completely unexpected. The level of care and attention he put into making sure everything looked perfect really stood out.

Our entire party — especially the birthday guest — was blown away and so appreciative of the effort that went into making the celebration memorable. It meant a lot to all of us.

Thank you to Nick and the team for such outstanding service and for making this event so special. We will definitely be coming back!

Our family loves Yard House! Whether we’re celebrating or just grabbing a bite, it always hits the mark. The kids devour their cheeseburgers and chicken tenders with crispy fries total comfort food. For us, the whiskey-glazed salmon and Thai grilled pork chops are packed with flavor, and the Whiskey Burger is a new favorite smoky, juicy, and bold. Drinks are just as impressive: my husband’s go-to is the House Belgian White and Smoked Old Fashioned, while I’m hooked on the Kiss and Tell cocktail. Desserts are a dream brookie, crème brûlée cheesecake, bread pudding and even the wings are worth mentioning. Great food, fun vibe, and something for everyone. Highly recommend!

We’ve been here multiple times and each time just gets better and better. Everything we’ve tried on the menu is excellent. Their drinks are also very good!!

Apps we’ve tried:
Poke nacho, fried calamari, firecracker shrimp, Cali roll stack.
What we enjoyed most: firecracker shrimp and Cali roll stack.

Entrees we’ve tried:
Sczechuan beef crispy noodle, orange chicken, Mac and cheese, truffle cheese burger.
What we enjoyed most: Orange chicken and beef noodle

If you’re looking for the best spot in Moorestown for happy hour, Yard House is the place to go. It has quickly become a local favorite for its lively atmosphere, excellent service, and unbeatable happy hour deals.

The portion sizes are huge, especially for the price, which makes it an incredible value. You get a large amount of quality food that feels more like a full dinner than just a quick bite. The standout items are definitely the poke nachos, which are fresh, flavorful, and piled high, and the spinach artichoke dip, creamy and rich with just the right amount of cheese. The chicken tenders are another must-try—crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and a perfect match for one of their many draft beers.

If you are tempted to try the Gardein wings, I would recommend skipping them, as they don’t quite hold up compared to the rest of the menu. Everything else, though, is top notch.

Between the portions, the prices, and the overall vibe, Yard House happy hour in Moorestown is one of the best deals around. Go with friends, share a few plates, and enjoy some of the best happy hour food you’ll find in the area.

Not a drinker anymore so I can't speak on the current beer selection, but was a huge fan before. Food is still good and I've always gotten lucky with good servers. Outdoor seating in the summer is always welcome. Being right next to the movies is a big plus as well. Parking is my only real complaint due to it being at the movie/mall entrance.

Our go-to weekend place! I love the variety in the menu, especially the many vegetarian options. The salads are fantastic, but I prefer to have the sauces on the side, as they can sometimes be a bit too much. The service has never been disappointing. Whether dining in or using curbside pickup, we have always had a great experience at this place. On weekends, especially Saturdays, dining in can involve a long wait, but it's definitely worth it. Apps and pizzas are half off during happy hour.The portions are huge, apps can make a meal.Korean bbq cheese steak is a must try.
Ok chicken sandwich for the price. Up charge for onion rings that tasted like microwaved. Service, drinks selection and venue was good.

Visited tonight during the late night hours (literally the last hour before closing), Hannah was an AMAZING server! We also ran into a slight issue with the food and the manager on duty (I believe his name was Ronald) was VERY kind, apologetic, and a problem solver. Overall the experience, especially with it being the last hour before closing, was a good one. I will definitely be back!

I grabbed a seat at the bar at Yard House in Nyack and immediately felt the energy. The place has a lively, sports-bar vibe with music, TVs, and a packed tap list.  The service was quick and friendly, and the food delivered quickly which was great as I was seeing a movie after lunch. Overall, a fun, spot I’d definitely return to for a casual night out.

We ordered the boneless wings, sliders and chicken wraps.  All were very tasty.  The drinks came out fast and cold.  The hostess tried to sit us at a dirty table, bench seat had oil and crumbs and table had crumbs and sauce all over.  Made her change tables, she did not seem happy.  Our waitress was awesome she made up for lazy hostess.  Overall we will be back.

Love this place and shout out to the best server, Nadean!
We've been here just a couple of times but our last few visits were tended by Nadean, an absolute delight! Im a super picky eater and tend to have a lot of special requests, but my girl makes me feel like a regular person - no irritation and my order always comes out perfect
The only reason for i pulled a star was because we were sat by the kitchen and my boyfriend is sound sensitive, so the constant dish clattering was rough for him
Maybe consider a sound barrier between the tables and the kitchen, at least by the sink?
Otherwise perfect

The Yard House restaurant is a popular and well regarded American casual dining restaurant chain that’s known for offering guests superbly made burgers, pizzas, salads and other delicious dishes.

In July of 2025, I brought and treated my wife and myself for dinner at the Yard House, specifically the branch located at the Palisades Center at West Nyack, New York and we very much enjoyed our dining experience.

The restaurant’s staff warmly greeted us upon arrival, and quickly provided us with a very large and comfortable dining table. Our server, Destiny D. was kind, welcoming and unquestionably professional. She did a great job on taking our menu orders, addressing our inquiries and always checked to make sure that we were having a great time. The Yard House is truly fortunate to have Destiny D as a member of their team.

In addition to the great service, both my wife and I were in awe of the restaurant’s energetic and vivacious atmosphere. We were impressed with its modern and stylish decor, and its display of multiple large television screens which feature live sports events and popular music programming. Guests also have access to a lively sports bar which features a vast collection of beers and cocktails.

Last but certainly not least, my wife and I absolutely enjoyed our meal!!! We found our guacamole and chips appetizer tasty and delightful!!! I ordered and loved my burger based entree while my wife ordered and loved her whiskey glazed salmon entree. We found our meals to be perfectly cooked, superbly seasoned and highly delicious!!!

All in all, we very much enjoyed our dining experience at the Yard House, and highly recommend for everyone to visit and dine at this great restaurant!!!

The chicken lettuce wraps with the sauce are the best I have EVER had! We love coming for these! My child was devouring the pizza before I could get a better picture! The Maui chicken dinner is phenomenal!!!! My husband loved his burger! Our server Malia was she was amazing!!! So attentive friendly and nice! She was on top of table drinks and other needs even on a busy Friday night! Thank you so much for a great meal! My family and I really enjoyed our meals and time together thank you for the fun family dinner !!

The food was so good! The staff was amazing. I took my fiance there for his birthday and he was so happy.

Lemon pepper chicken is great. The fish tacos are huge. The appetizers can fill you up but they taste great. The MAC AND CHEESE surprised me! It was so creamy and good.

Next time I go I'm definitely getting the shrimp tempura!
The cocktail service was great the margarita was tasty and great beer selection will definitely be back again

The food was decent , but the service was disappointing. Our waitress, Tania, was friendly at first, but when my friend asked for a few modifications to her order, she rolled her eyes, made faces, and audibly groaned. When we mentioned it to another waiter, he simply said, “That’s just how she is.” That’s not an acceptable excuse for poor customer service. I hope management addresses this, because guests deserve to be treated with respect.

Do better Yard House

A beer lovers paradise. If you love or even just "like" beers, you should be able to find one that placates your palate. Located on the 4th level of the Palisades Mall, a very nice place to take a break from your power shopping and get a quick bite. Service is quick and pleasant.  Today was a late lunch so we opted for a Cobb Salad, which was chocked full of goodies. We added grilled chicken to it, and it is a perfect complement. We started on a jumbo pretzel complete with cheese sauce and mustard. This pretzel is really "jumbo"! We had a local IPA in a pub mug, but you can order it, or any beer, in a Yard glass.  I thought it was pretty decent for a locally brewed IPA. For a sweet treat we knocked down an Oreo Brookie. Ooof! A few extra laps on the treadmill or around the mall for sure. But worth it. Ordering and payment is conveniently accomplished by the on table digital system. Worked perfectly.  If your at the mall, definitely check out the Yard house as it is yards away from the fast food purveyors. I think you'll like it.

Our favorite place to have dinner with casual way. Located at the palisades mall, it is easier to get park.

Their food is amazing and also the sangria is yummy 🤩
I loved the ambience.
The server is very friendly.

We had also our family dinner after our wedding in this place. So casual but meaningful. We got free champagne from the server.

Highly recommended

The vibe here seems like it is more suitable for adults socializing and drinking. We needed to find a good restaurant on our way up to Quebec. Found this and wanted to try. The kids were okay. They enjoyed the food. Service was nice as well. Salmon was delicious.

This place is huge. Big American lounge bar, with 120 différents beers, also mini tasting beer, it's impressive! It s nice and clean. Menu is amazing with lot of choices, also we can see pictures of every dishes on a pad, and call the waitresses on a pad. Service is fast and our waitress was lovely. The food was a big portion, and tasted delicious.

It’s been many years since I’ve been to yard house and I was not completely disappointed. Service was spotty and alll the servers looked pissed off, but besides that the crispy Brussel sprouts are amazing & the spicy beef noodles were also good. My server recommended a guava beer that I loved as well. Overall I would come back again!

Had to wait 10 minutes to seat because they were changing servers. Once seated server came quickly & was attentive. Food was good. My daughter loved the margarita pizza. Only downside was the music was blasting, so it was hard to talk.

I visit this location when I’m at the palisades mall. It can get a little loud on turn days and you may need to wait for a table but it’s worth the wait.

My drinks are always good. If you love bourbon you’ll love the Old 43🥰. My server recommended it and it was delicious.

We had the spinach dip with chip and the Korean chill wings. Both were delicious. For dinner I had the pineapple glazed chicken. It was good. I didn’t eat the pineapples the chunks were too big for my taste.

This is a good spot to eat at the prices are reasonable and it’s convenient when shopping the mall, or going to the movies which is located in the mall as well. If your going to the comedy show it’s on the same for as well.

Parking is available with a direct door to enter, we just have t figured it out. We normally just park in the mall parking and take the elevator up

This is my first time at this location. They had 120 different type of beers for you to select. They also have cocktail and wine. The food was good and the atmosphere was nice. They have television all over the location, some with music video, other with sports channels.  It was a nice lunch after shopping at the mall.

Amazing food and amazing service.  I got myself the whisky glaze and pepper boneless wings as an appetizer.  Super good.  Amazing flavor from the sauce and the chicken was definitely high quality.  Juicy and very tender with a phenomenal crisp on the outside.

I then got myself the Whisky and white aged cheddar cheese burger with house fries.  It was super delicious and juicy.  Good quality meat and everything was jam packed with delicious flavor.  Highly recommend.  Service was amazing and as was everything else.  I’ll definitely be coming back.  Also my waiter gave me a sample of a beer he recommended and I loved it.  Ordered a pint of it afterwards.

Great spot for lunch (and probably happy hour and dinner too!) - very impressed by the food! I had blackened salmon over kale and quinoa - 600ish calories and very healthy! Of course there were also SO MANY other delicious choices - burgers, sandwiches, entrees and apps - that looked great. Huge beer selection. Reasonably priced. Great service!

Have been doing take out with them on a few occasions and the food is great the Philly Sandwich is amazing. The only thing is when we do take out the wait time is not great. When you ask the host for the order they go to the back and you wind up waiting a while for them to come back, then they have to pack the order and even though they give you an estimated time its usually never ready. Would definitely need improvement there.

The sweet and spicy shrimp pasta today Wednesday was not it. It was dry. Definitely a different cook. I had this before on a Thursday in the restaurant and it was amazing. Another thing this dish is way too expensive for half a cup of pasta. I would appreciate more pasta.  It's such a good dish when done correctly. I drove from PA all the way over here on my birthday for this....very disappointed. And no I didn't eat a lot what you see in the picture was literally one little bite out of it. That's just how little noodles they serve with it.

We celebrated my 31st birthday here and we had the pleasure of having Carmen as our server. She was very attentive and accommodating since my sister is vegan. She made sure we were good at all times and we appreciated it very much. Thank you so much Carmen. 10 stars if I could

Great food and service especially for a chain restaurant! We come to this specific location frequently because of the friendly staff and the consistently high quality food. The dishes look just their photos. Whoever is running the kitchen knows how to handle high volumes well. Servers are prompt with refills and food is served to your table at reasonable times. Friday and Saturday date nights at YardHouse are a great way to end the week and enjoy a tasty dinner with a sweet treat for dessert. The table tablet is very convenient for easy ordering, paying by card and even splitting the bill if you’re with a large party. YardHouse is always a good time!

We went here for graduation dinner for my daughter. First the service was excellent, waitress was so friendly. The Big Pretzel was so soft and delicious. The burger was juicy ,the  turkey sandwich was huge and delicious too and the penne vodka chicken pasta was amazing. Definitely we will be back! We love it!

What a great place! So many different beers on draft, your choices are almost endless! 3 types of ciders which is my favorite! Our server was very attentive. The manager even came by to see if everything was ok. The food was really good! We got the jambalaya and the shrimp tacos. Amazing! We also had some half priced apps during the late afternoon early evening. That helped our bill be so low compared to other places. We went to the comedy club afterwards, great affordable couples night out.

OK I have been to several locations for this chain.Most in MA.

The good the service tried really hard and given several things were out. They were mobbed putting it politely. So, they  really tried.

The bad for this location only.

The bathroom out of toilet paper all stalls and close to a toxic waste site. I have been to the Burlington MA one not an issue there.

I would suggest just at a less crazy hour. I think a difference between the 2 locations is the MA site has less of a sports bar vibe. This isn't much of a surprise as MA legally doesn't allow happy hour and the location is different also.

Excellent food and most of all EXCELLENT SERVICE! I have to give a HUGE thanks to our server Savannah! She is so warm, hospitable, and gracious. She made us feel welcomed! Great job YARD HOUSE. A special thank you to Mgr. Andy, too!
-signed a grateful (will be returning) customer

Went here to meet my brothers for some bonding time. There was no NFL games going on, so we were able to grab a booth without a wait.

Our server, Maria, was awesome, she was very attentive to our needs.

I typically order a burger when I go to these places. I upgraded to some truffle fries. The sesame seed bun was a great touch on the burger, but the patty itself doesn’t taste high quality fresh. More like it was previously frozen.

Besides that, the place was great. TV’s in every nook and cranny you can imagine. Will come again.

VERY,VERY BUSY PLACE. I was by myself because I was on a business trip first night which was Friday and could not get a seat at the bar. So I opted to come back the next evening and got a seat. The bartenders were very friendly and very knowledgeable of what they were serving. Joked around and had a good time and seemed like their jobs. I got a ribeye steak with mashed potatoes. Those cooked perfection even when I asked them to make sure the steak was dry. I can always tell what kind of meat facility serves when you don't put anything like steak, butter or spices on it. You should not have to do that. And I'm telling you that the steak was a very prime, a good grade of steak. Overall, that atmosphere was great. A little dark for my taste but that's what you get when you go to a place like this. If you're going to visit here, plan to make sure that you see that they're going to be on a wait no matter what. Can't wait to go back. In fact, I'll probably be the one in Florida in a few weeks

Yard House is a sports bar / restaurant, located at the Moorestown Mall (Moorestown, New Jersey).  The food is delicious.

My server was Taylor.  She did a great job, serving my meal.  The entire staff did exceptionally well.  On multiple occasions, I was impressed with the professionalism of the staff.

I highly recommend that guests check out this restaurant.  You can comfortably have a few beers, while watching the latest sporting events at Yard House.  In fact, there are several big-screen televisions, broadcasting a variety channels.

Sometimes, Yard House is packed, increasing your wait-time just a bit. The food makes the wait-time worthwhile, though.

Have a blessed day.
This is a great place to go if you want to meet friends out they have an array of beers if you like crafted beers. Their garlic noodles are amazing. I mostly like the garlic noodles with the lobster.

First time here but will be back!  Came in for half off happy hour food specials.  I had the lettuce chicken wraps which were delicious!  Date had the Magherita Pizza that looked yummy.  We chose to sit at bar to have cocktail while waiting for table, but then decided to just eat there.  Server was friendly and helpful with choosing cocktail and describing menu.  The place was busy but not insane.  The tables seemed wide and we would have sat on same side to be able to have conversation.  Not the most intimate atmosphere but would be great for groups!

Ten of us had a birthday celebration at The Yard House at Willow Grove Mall, and it was a fantastic experience! The server was perfect, always attentive, but never rushing us. The food was excellent, and we ordered a variety of appetizers and entrées. Everyone enjoyed their food! Yard House supplied a birthday dessert for my husband's birthday.  I've been  another Yard House, and  this one is definitely better!

It was just okay. Food was not the best burger was dry. French fries were overcooked. They brought out the wrong burger. The salad should have never been served it was brown and not good overall. I don't think we will return.

Food and service was great!  My daughters took me out for Mother's Day and I'd have to say, wonderful choice.  Ray, our server, was so nice and spot on.  The welcome from the first 2 young ladies when we walked in, was nice.  Will dine here again.

Our food: Blackened shrimp tacos
Bar-b-que bacon cheeseburger
Classic cheeseburger with sweet potato fries

Be aware when ordering take out.  One of the most important things about a restaurant is consistency.  Every time I have ordered food from this establishment I have to keep my fingers crossed because I don't know I'm going to get.  Sometimes I'm pleasantly pleased, but most times my food order is grossly messed up, to the point of me no longer wanting to get my food from here ever again.  Most times, I order their cheesesteak.  Out of 10 orders, my sandwich was prepared correctly only two times... I am not exaggerating.   How in the area of the Philly cheesesteak can a sandwich get messed up so badly.  Tonight's order really takes the cake.  I ordered my cheesesteak and asked them to add fried onions.  You would think that's a simple enough request... well... when I got home and looked at my sandwich it was drizzled with canned crispy onions!  The ones you buy off the shelf in the salad prep aisle of the market.  What chef does not know what fried onions are??  Who made my sandwich?!... someone off the street with absolutely no cooking experience.   Ridiculous...

Happy hour is fantastic. Great 1/2 priced app deal and good drink deals. Bartenders are all wonderful, especially Hannah. Food is certainly elevated from what you’d expect from the pub atmosphere and prices. Brussels, poke nachos and Cali Stack are delicious.

On a recent Saturday, we experienced a wait time of approximately 25-30 minutes, which extended to about 40 minutes before we were seated. We were quite surprised to find a spacious dining area with a noticeable number of unoccupied tables.

Jeremy, our server, was very helpful in guiding us to our table and thoroughly explaining the menu, drink selections, and various food combination options. He continued to be very attentive throughout our visit. The food was enjoyable and served in moderate portions.

We found the ambiance to be a bit too dim, with spotlights from the ceiling creating a somewhat dark atmosphere. This could potentially pose a challenge for individuals with vision difficulties when trying to read the menu or clearly see their food.

Parking was quite difficult, as the lot was consistently full. The KOP mall is conveniently located nearby.

The food was really good, I like the dim setting as well. My mom got the fish and chips and it was massive. Her tartar sauce was so good she had to take some to go. I went to a different location and thought I didn't like cheese curds. Tried it again at this one and it was night and day difference! They're actually really good.

This spacious restaurant is a great place to have fun with your partner or friends. The huge selection of beer and excellent cuisine will not leave you indifferent. We tested the quality of the food by ordering a hamburger and a salad. And I swear it was the best burger I've had in years! Weekends are very busy, so if you want a table, it's best to book in advance.

Nice large restaurant with ample seating  indoors and outdoors with a large bar area. We stopped in for a few drinks and they have a nice menu with delicious  dishes to choose from. Good service with a  helpful and friendly staff.

Another number of things was bothering me during this visit typically they have pretty OK food. However, there was a guy in a booth, pointing a laser at one of the bartenders, and nobody seem to do anything about it. Then the other frightening thing was we saw a mouse running behind the bar. So at that time I was ready to leave the bartender gave us a $25 off gift card to apologize. However, it was frightening to see a mouse running around.

Parking is normally never an issue. However, the bar is pretty dirty even the counter tops.

Seriously, the food here is on another level! The atmosphere is fantastic, and we got a great booth after just a 15-minute wait.
The only weird part was our waiter. The guy with glasses looked completely checked out, like he was being forced to work. The most bizarre part was when I said I was paying in cash, and he just deadpanned, "That's not my problem." Nice one, dude.
Honestly, though, the food makes it all worth it. I'd still give this place five stars!

I orderer two burgers to go. One was the classic burger and the other was the whiskey and blue cheese burger. I assumed they were the correct burgers when I looked at them thru the clear tops. I got home and they were the wrong burgers. Both had mushrooms which my husband can’t eat because he has gout. I couldn’t eat the burger I got because I can American cheese.

I called to speak to the manager because I had a complaint and was told to call back another day. I spent $95.00 for two wrong burgers nachos to go and two martinis. The worst customer service ever!!!!.
My waiter was great and had great suggestions. My steak was like an 8 out of 10, it was fatty but everything was delicious.

I usually go to the Yard House in Willow Grove. Unfortunately, we weren’t comfortable with their response regarding reservations for Thanksgiving.
So we choose the King of Prussia location.  The restaurant was much bigger than I expected. The service as well as the food, was excellent. We are not big fans of driving to KOP but for the service we had, it would be a worthy trip.

The Nashville hot items should be renamed. Nashville Hot is a pretty specific taste profile and this wasn't it. It was bland, no heat at all. BUT everything else was fantastic!! Great onion rings and cheese curds. Superb Nachos and amazing humus and pita app. Service was friendly if not a little inattentive (forgivable due to volume). And it's neat impossible to have a conversation with the music. All in all it was a pleasant experience. Probably a better lunch spot for us rather than dinner.

As a bartender, it is very rare that a spicy marg impresses me. It is even more rare for me to like it so much I repeatedly come back for it. Dee makes an absolutely PHENOMENAL spicy margarita. Every time I see her in here I am immediately excited knowing I get to actually enjoy one of my favorite drinks without making it myself. Huge s/o to her. I also love every single bartender here, they’re always super welcoming and down to earth. I work 2 minutes away, and this is the perfect end to my night after a long shift.

Booked a Birthday gathering for my daughter. Our server, Christina, was excellent!! Very warm, friendly, attentive and accommodating to our group. Hostess and other staff were also very kind  and helped me decorate the table too. Managers I worked with to coordinate this celebration, Nikki and Dan, were so easy to work with, communication super and had ideas to make the occasion extra special for my daughter. Overall, I highly recommend dining here and/or booking a celebration! We had an extremely wonderful experience. Thank you so much Yard House!
Yard house is our family’s go-to option when everyone wants something different. The service is always great! Food is good overall it’s not top tier but this place never disappoints.

I wouldn't recommend this Yard House location, based on other locations I've been to in the past. I wish I could remember our server's name - because she was pretty awful. I'm not sure why she had such a bad attitude. The restaurant isn't very clean, either. I refused to drink the water because multiple cups had floating bits and particles in the water. The silverware was dirty. When I had one set of silverware resting on an appetizer plate, the server came by and aggressively took all of our app. plates and then slammed our silverware right onto the (probably unclean) table, so I asked for new silverware - which again, wasn't the cleanest. When I ordered my porkchop, I told the server that I like my porkchop the rarest possible, which is medium in the restaurant industry. The head chef or manager came out before our food was served and told me that he can't serve a rare porkchop and that for food service regulations, it needs to be at least medium. I told him that I said those EXACT words to our server. I can't say that the food was bad, though, because it wasn't. Everyone's meals were pretty great and fresh. I also wanted to point out that one of the server's drink Stations at the front of the restaurant must have had a leak or some sort of drainage issue. During our late lunch/ early dinner, a maintenance guy was fixing it. He was transporting dirty drain hoses from the front of the restaurant to the back, all through the dining room during meal services. I'd recommend this place to anyone who doesn't value cleanliness in a food establishment!
I don't live in the area, but I go to Yard House everytime I'm in town for the chicken nachos. Service is always good, but this time, my server Avery was awesome! Thank you for the great experience!

I recently dined at Yard House and had a wonderful experience. The menu offerings are extensive, with something for everyone, and every dish ordered was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. The service was attentive, friendly! Highly recommend.

I brought my mom to grab dinner as a special treat since she doesn’t go out very often. We tried three other restaurants nearby but they all had long wait times. We were promised 15 minutes but waited 35, watching as people who came after us got seated. It’s not like the place was packed either. We ended up leaving. I admit we don’t dress the fanciest but we’re nice people who tip well. Super disappointed.

My husband and I went here on a weekend. This place was packed in the evening. Had to wait 20-30 minutes to get a table. Tip I can give you join there waitlist before you arrive. In their website we cannot make reservations but can jump on to a queue.
Their cocktails were really good. And the boneless BBQ chicken wings went well with cocktails. Food was really good as well. Place were loud and lively. We loved the vibe here. A typical weekend night with cocktails, good food, great conversations and lots of laughs.

A Fun Spot with Great Vibes, Tasty Food, and the Sweetest Service!

Yard House in King of Prussia is one of my favorite go-to spots, especially when I’m out with friends. Their beer selection is incredible—seriously a paradise for beer lovers. I love that they let you try three samples before you commit, which is such a fun and thoughtful touch.

The food is just as impressive. I’m a vegetarian, but that doesn’t stop me from enjoying their chicken nachos—they’re my absolute favorite! We just get the chicken on the side so my friends can have it, and it works out perfectly every time. It’s great to see a place that makes it easy for everyone to enjoy a meal together, no matter their dietary preferences.

The cherry on top? They give you a free dessert on your birthday, and the servers are some of the sweetest I’ve encountered. Friendly, attentive, and genuinely happy to make your day special. That kind of service really makes the whole experience stand out.

Highly recommend Yard House for a great time, great food, and great people!

From the moment I walked in, I thought the place was beautiful and spacious. The lighting was dim—just the way I like it—and the music was perfect. Emely, my server, was very attentive and helped me choose some beers; this restaurant boasts an impressive selection of craft beers from all over the world. Emely helped me make my selection based on my preferences—I happen to love German beers. The food was a 10/10, and the dessert was absolutely to die for. I give it a 10/10 recommendation.
Exceptional service, food and atmosphere. My kids said they loved the appetizers 10/10 before the entrees came lol. Awesome experience, thank you.
Fast, large portions, friendly service and a large selection of beer! Pork chop was on the saltier side, but overall no complaints. Our server was so pleasant and professional.

Me and my friend came to Yard House at Ridgehill. Our wait was Faith and she is amazing, very attentive, caring and takes the time to make your experience positive and welcoming. I'll definitely be coming back!

Visited Aug 30, 2025. Order chicken Nachos and Korean chicken bbq and a few beers. We had also had a few friends who joined us as well and agreed with me. They had tacos and few drinks as well. The service was good but what was disturbing our waiter at the bar took our ordered but did not come over, except maybe twice. We had a number of waitresses come over to ask if we needed anything and were very kind and professional. Our first waiter was a male and not very attentive. We all sat at the bar. The atmosphere was a little dark but ok. We all left a good tip though the amount we left was not deserved. I have been here a few times and always enjoyed their food and services.

Today I decided to dine alone at this restaurant, and I was genuinely impressed. From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel welcomed and valued. The service was not only attentive but also carried a warmth and professionalism that elevated the entire experience. Every detail, from the timing of the courses to the thoughtful gestures of the servers, reflected a commitment to excellence. It is rare to encounter such consistency and care, and this restaurant has truly set a new standard for me. Without hesitation, I will return to once again enjoy the remarkable hospitality they so generously provide.
No cash atmosphere, cards and tap did have to go to load bug other than that awesome place kids love it 😀 I sure did.

The service was absolutely terrible; the waiter only came to the table twice, and they got my order wrong both times. I sat in the restaurant for over an hour and a half, and they never managed to bring me the correct order—they kept bringing the wrong dish. The service was very poor; the waiters don't really know how to listen to or properly attend to customers. In the end, I wound up eating french fries that were soggy and oversalted.

The wait was not long at all and the food came out quick. The music was nice and not too loud. There is so many options to choose from and the atmosphere was nice. My first time at The Yard House and we had a amazing server by the name of Madisen. Madisen was polite, helpful and very patient. Since it was my first time and the menu had so much to choose from  Madisen helped me by giving me recommendations after I told her what I was looking for, it was as if she studied the menu.. lol. I was not disappointed at all!! She checked in on us and made sure we were satisfied with our choices.

Thank you so Madisen for your service.

Great chain restaurant.

This location has friendly staff and a great manager. Waitress was friendly and made sure we were okay.  Food came out fast and tasted great.

There is a variety of beer to choose from and a great list of cocktails as well.
Service was a little slow but the food and drinks were worth the wait.

Had a play date in the area at Lego land and decided to have lunch here. We were NOT disappointed with our choice. Service was a bit slow in the beginning. We opted to sit outside as it was a beautiful day out. Staff were nice and friendly. Food was AMAZING ! Even something as simple as the pizza was a hit with both the kids and the adults. Their menu is extensive but not overwhelming and I love the way they break it down by various categories (forgot to take a pic). They even have a section specifically for those who want meals under 700 calories. I thought that was pretty dope. The pink dragonfruit margarita was so refreshing that we ordered another round to go. Yes, you can order a Togo drink. The ambience is quite relaxing mixed with the right amount of busyness. I would most definitely recommend this restaurant.

Wow!!! I had the lobster noodle and it was absolutely delicious! With lots of huge shrimps and lobster meat with a little asian twist so good!! My husband had the steak bowl with quinoa and he loved it and those truffle fries yessss!!!

Actually, my mom and I ended up at this outdoor mall hoping to find desired sneakers in our size. However, she started feeling a little weak from the heat, so we left and decided to walk over to Yard House and have lunch. Thankfully, that was the best decision we made about where to fill our bellies. The atmosphere was pleasant and many guests had their eyes glued to the game while still enjoying their meals. We were blessed to be initially served by a warm, pleasant and handsome host named LV. He assisted us with a caring heart and a beautiful smile, especially with navigating the digital menu, until shortly later, his shift ended. Needless to say, we did not expect anymore professional and accommodating host/hostess to serve us. However, thankfully we had the pleasure of being served by a lovely hostess named Natasha. She also had a beautiful smile, which seemed to match her heart. Furthermore, after receiving our meals, although it was happy hour and pretty busy, our hostess still made sure to check on us. She was very pleasant and displayed impeccable customer service/relations skills. She also helped us navigate the digital menu, and showed even more generosity by assisting me with adding time to the parking app. I certainly did not desire to obtain any parking violations. Thankfully, it was a win-win!

Went there to watch the Bills vs Ravens game and the restaurant didn’t disappoint  and neither did the Bills. Our server Charlie aka Chuck was very attentive and made sure my friend and I were good. Great personality with excellent service. The food was delicious and the Cheese Curds are the best thing I ever had.

Had a bit of an issue with Janus hostess. Her customer service needs a bit of work. Went to speak with manager Jesse. He was amazing, friendly and accommodating. The bartender Sophia so great too. Had an amazing night after the little hiccup. I want to thank Jesse and Sophia keep up the amazing work. If im ever back in Yonkers. I'll be back. They had great music and it was clean. Loved the vibe the rest of the night.

The food was good. We came here for happy hour and they did not disappoint. Service was very quick. I had a black cherry ale that was really, really good. I was pleasantly surprised by it. The buffalo chicken pizza was eehh, but no complaints about anything else. It's a great place to bring the family or grab a bite before going to the movies.

I had a very disappointing experience at Yard House Yonkers on Monday evening1/19/2026. My husband and I sat at the bar, and from the beginning, the bartender, Ashley, was unwelcoming and dismissive. We were ignored for an extended period of time, and when I finally asked for a drink, her response and body language were rude and uncomfortable. The treatment felt discriminatory and immediately set a negative tone.
The situation became worse when my drink was served with what appeared to be a Object inside (possibly a bug or debris), which was extremely disturbing and unacceptable from a health and safety standpoint. After that, I tried several times to get Ashley’s attention, but she continued to ignore me.
When a manager eventually came over, I was cut off and not allowed to fully explain what happened. The drink was refunded, but the issue was never properly addressed. This experience raises serious concerns about customer service, professionalism, and basic hygiene standards.
Management should be aware of this incident and take it seriously. No customer should feel ignored, disrespected, or unsafe consuming food or drinks at a restaurant.
Jesse was amazing tonight! He recommended an awesome gin mix that I absolutely loved and made sure to keep my water glass full. Great service and awesome atmosphere, will be back!

This location is located in Ridgehill. After a little shopping or after a movie is a good place to go eat. The place is big. It has a good selection and food and drinks, especially their beer selection. Also options for children. Staff was also very pleasant.

I went with my friends and we had a great time. Our server was Joey and he was extremely helpful. He knew the menu like the back of his hand and helped us choose what to eat. The appetizers, dinner, drinks and dessert are 10/10. Great atmosphere.
Great food laid back atmosphere, competent staff..
Amazing food great service at the bar very please !!!

Great experience! Went with friends and kids, everyone was happy with their meals. The food was delicious and our server was excellent. My favorites were the poke nachos, the salad and the chicken wings.

Yard House is a great place for both casual dinners and group gatherings. The menu has plenty of variety, so everyone can find something they enjoy, and the food is consistently fresh and flavorful. The service was friendly, attentive, and made the experience even better.
The atmosphere is lively without feeling overwhelming, making it a good spot to watch a game, meet with friends, or enjoy a family meal. If you're looking for good food, excellent service, and a wide selection of drinks, Yard House is definitely worth a visit.

Yard House was the only place I ate Yesterday. When I got my Cheese Curds Appetizer they looked very pale like they were undercooked but this is also my first time eating at Yard House so I’m thinking maybe this is how they usually look. They taste undercooked and I’m making this review because last night I left with stomach pain thinking it would pass and this morning I woke up feeling sick. Again Yard house for dinner was my first meal of the day. My Veggies burger was really good, no complaints on that.

Typical sports bar with plenty of seating. Plenty of different beer options on tap as well along with spiked seltzers. Food was pretty good with a varied menu. Shitske Mushroom noodles were absolutely delicious. The service, while serviceable and inoffensive, was a bit ho hum and nothing too noteworthy.   Overall, a plausible option to patron during your shopping excursion.

We had a great time and our server Danny M. was awesome. Super nice and impressively knowledgeable of the huge beer list. I was also very pleasantly surprised that they have Garein plant-based meat options for a lot of the menu. That was a huge plus. The only thing I'd say I didn't love was how loud the speakers were. It was a little tough to talk to others at the table. Other than that, I'd say one of my favorite places in KOP.
Had a couple beers while watching World Cup game.  Air conditioning was broken and it was 102 degrees outside.

Ryan the bartender was great! Friendly and awesome. Had the 2 taco combo dish and was delicious! Especially with the vampire crust! I want that the global standard! And I heard music that I haven't in ages and loved it!

Was great overall! The drinks were delicious (The dragon cosmo was a really really good recommendation!) The food was fairly priced and the chicken nachos are honestly my favorite, I couldn't take a good photo cause I couldn't stop eating them!
Server was attentive and very nice, only downside was my dessert was packed up and they forgot to bring my container of hardly eaten wings I was going to save for later and I realized way too late it wasn't in my bag :') Everything tasted great aside from that

We ate here for my son's 11th birthday. The hostesses greeted us with pleasant smiles. Our waitress, Liz was very polite and accommodating.  Our food was well prepared delicious and a gracious portion size. At the end of our meal Liz brought out a delicious brookie topped with ice cream in celebration of my son's birthday.  This experience is one we will never forget.  10/10 in all areas!!!!! Simply AMAZING ♥️

First time here and bit disappointed. Heard so many good things about this place. Ordered a margarita pizza was good but was little cold. Ordered plain wings and got wrong wings and had to send back. Got cheese curds which weren’t bad but very greasy. Had problem checking out with credit card.  May go back and try again.

First time here and pleasantly surprised in a good way. They're located in the Willowbrook mall vicinity- so plenty of parking. The place is really big inside with ample seating.  Great play list 🎵🎶 Our bar tender Eric was excellent and made me the  best drinks!! Now lets get to the food....delicious!!! We started off with The Coco Passion and Orange Yardcicle SO GOOD. We opted for the Korean bbq Cheesesteak with sweet potato fries and coleslaw & the Whiskey Glazed Salmon.  The portion sizes were perfect, filling and deliciously prepared. Turned around and tried the New Holland Dragon's Milk- (good dark beer- similar to Guiness but Better) and for dessert the Bread Pudding with Caramel Crème Anglaise 😋 Great experience overall. Definitely recommend and will come back!! 👌

It was incredibly delicious! The combination of flavors was so unique and amazing. Everything we tried was absolutely delicious. Highly recommend this place to anyone who loves good food and interesting flavor combinations.❣️😋😋😋

Went to grab some dinner with friends. I got the steak bowl and my friend got the shrimp bowl. Both under 700 cals. Made fresh. Delicious. Good vibes, everyone watching the world cup at the same time. Plenty of parking outside in the willow brook mall plaza.

Always delicious, fun, the service is wonderful. Nice music and it doesn’t feel like people are on top of you or listening in on your conversations. Great selection of drinks and food. Never misses! I always come back
Service was extraordinarily sloooooowwwww. They offer tasting of the beers! Tacos and truffle fries were very yummy. Blt was dry and disappointing.

Having never been to a yard house I have to say they had a lot to choose from in the menu.

We got onion rings and firecracker shrimp.
The onion rings were so soggy and full of grease.
The shrimp was ok.

The meals just ok. The cheesesteaks cheese wasn’t even melted.
My Maui chicken was good but I didn’t like the rice or broccoli.
My husband had the jambalaya he said was good.

I would like to try yard house again but maybe not this one.

Our waitress had an attitude like we were bothering her being there.

I liked the atmosphere. We sat by the kitchen which was way to loud with banging of pots and pans.

It was a wonderful experience! Stephen was our server- very nice and attendant. Atmosphere is dark and toasty. Me and my fiancé ordered the chicken nachos for the appetizer in which we were amazed at the portion size. The size of the appetizer was for like three people to eat. For our son we ordered the chicken tenders and fries which was also a big size for an almost two year old. For main dishes I ordered the pineapple chicken was very flavorful. My fiancé ordered the orange chicken which was also very delicious. Lastly, for dessert we ordered the s’mores brownie dessert- which was recommended by our server. Good Choice because it was also very good! Will be coming back soon!

My homegirl and I went and let me tell you how great it was! It was a Thursday evening, walked in and we were seated right away. Ashley took really great care of us!
