She was attentive, friendly, kind, and absolute people person without being overbearing. This is coming from someone who is an introvert. One of the best dining experiences I've had in a while. She went over the gluten free menu with me and double checked with me before putting any gf orders through. Seriously, awesome service! Thanks Ashley! The food was fabulous! I had the chicken lettuce wraps for my app 10/0 the sauces were magnificent! Then I had the shrimp tacos on corn tortilla (no cheese) with jasmine rice and beans for my entree. Usually when you have a modified dish, it tastes like something is missing, this meal did not! It was still packed with flavor. We also had dragonfruit martinis. It was a bit sweet but would totally recommend after a long day. We truly enjoyed and did not feel rushed at all! Honestly, I'd go back there tonight but self control is needed. Great experience, great vibe 10/10!

Excellent selection of beers and food. Good atmosphere, and a nice place to hang to watch a game or meet for a meal and drinks with friends. The Birria Tacos are smaller than I've had elsewhere, but the flavor and texture of the tacos is consistent across locations I've visited and it came with delicious cilantro lime rice and beans. The margherita pizza is pretty tasty, as is everything else I've tried on the menu. Definitely recommend giving it a try.

We had an amazing experience at Yaad House Restaurant! From the moment we walked in, we were impressed by the clean, spacious, and comfortable environment. The drinks were perfectly crafted, and the food… oh my goodness! As lovers of spice and herbs, we were thrilled to find the perfect balance of flavors—absolutely delicious! The service was top-notch, with the server, sous chef, and hostess all being incredibly welcoming and attentive. We visited after our vows to have lunch with our family, and everyone was more than pleased with their meals. Thank you, Yaad House Family, for making our day even more special. This was our 4th visit to the Wayne location, and once again, our expectations were exceeded. We will definitely be coming back! 🫶🏻

Thank you guys for adding an appetizer on the house for congratulating us on ours vows, Sous Chef 🧑‍🍳  your an awesome person, cap off keep up the excellent work, he check in with all the guest work ethic above and beyond  🫶🏻 forgot is name now but he work yesterday 6am - 3pm shift slim & intelligent gentleman 🙏we appreciate you 🫶🏻

Ordered crispy Brussel sprout as appetizer, it’s overly oily and saggy. Got a pink dragon, drink is ok. Also ordered the sesame crusted ahi tuna as dinner, the rice that came with it, it’s a simple one bite rice ball. The veggie, no taste at all. Sesame crusted ahi tuna is no taste as well.

09/25/2025
Always enjoy coming here, if it's not too crowded.
Since we'd caught 'happy hour' and decided to just munch on a few apps. The Poke nachos (amazing as always)... blackened Ahi sashimi,
an order of chicken lettuce wrap, and some spicy hummus. All very good.
TONS of amazing beers along with mixed drinks and even wine can be had as you watch your favorite sport show.

I have been to this location so many times but I am writing a review for the first time specifically for our server Samantha. We came on a very busy FIFA final game day and got treated better than ever. Samantha went above and beyond and made sure we had our food and beverages right in time with zero issues. Great job  Samantha and I really appreciate you for being so friendly, calm, fast and providing continuous service with no delays at all. God bless.

With 100+ beer taps, this establishment offers one of the largest assortments of draft beer in the area where my partner and I stopped for lunch as first-timers to this location. Situated on the edge of the Willowbrook Mall in Wayne, the Yard House is a stylish pub. Upon arrival, we were greeted by the staff and got a booth right away. The restaurant is open and spacious with a modern vibe where TVs are planted throughout with sports. The layout is different from that of the American Dream mall, sans the view of the ski slope. Their all-day menu offers appetizers, salads, pizza, burgers, sandwiches, tacos, and main entrees. We decided on 10 crispy traditional chicken wings, classic cheeseburger sliders, tomato bisque soup, and Parmesan truffle fries. To wash them down, we had a Radler and Blackberry Cider. The food was solid, fresh, flavorful, and still hot when it reached the table. Good portion size, and the price was reasonable. Our server, Kimmy, was personable and knowledgeable, ensuring that we had everything we needed. This place always hits the spot, offering a great combination of good food, a fantastic drink selection, and a welcoming atmosphere, which we can recommend.

Large group but food was very good everyone enjoyed it.
The nachos were already dug into that’s how good it was. Not a picture of everything.
Salmon very well seasoned. Filet mignon she felt was too small. The ribeye with added shrimp was good but not enough fat rendered off. It’s better to either cook enough where it’s crisp or cut it off.
Jambalaya he enjoyed it, but very large portion for one person. Someone had a burger not sure which, but they enjoyed the truffle fries.

Waiter name David sucks….  He was yawning as he was taking our orders. And brought back wrong drink.. And he was mia for the most part of our dinner.
Fried calamari was like breadcrumbs,rest of the food was mediocre (which one of them was the most expensive item on the menu) 20oz ribeye….
I don’t know anyone that could make a ribeye taste mediocre other than this place. It wasn’t worst ever but I can easily say never again….  Oh all of this is happening while this guy is walking around clueless and hanging out by the bar… check the pic. lol

Always here and the service is always great, but Danielle K. was NEXT LEVEL. Super attentive, the absolute BEST we’ve ever had! It’s the little things ya know!? (Never having to ask for a refill, bring extra napkins, ask how everything is or bring the check.) Service like that is important so TIP your server well! BEST Lemon Pepper wings around!  Large Pretzel/Cheese Curds/burgers are always great but these wings are freakin PHENOMENAL… Must try!

Overall decent meal, I enjoy the seared tuna. Family friendly venue. Service was good for the fact that they had to accommodate our party of three at the same time as a party of 20+. Be careful if you are with the kids as the tablet games are an extra $2.99 which automatically gets added to your bill. With tip for my husband daughter and I my husband and I paid about $50each =$100 total for two mains, a kids meal, and two brunch cocktails, so a bit on the medium - pricy side. Food was good though.

Loved it, diffently going back, and they cater to vegetarian, and to anyone who dont drink alcohol, they have a great selection.  Now my waiter,  Mo, was the best. She went above and beyond, i really appreciated it. This will be my new, go out with friends and watch the games  spot

Yard house was always my friends favorite 😍 go to place beacuse of the variety of the drinks and wide range of food available there. The lady who served us was very generous and getting us to try the house favorite drinks intially as a trial which helped us to choose the best drink named Golden Pilsner. We also ordered mushroom pizza, truffle fries and espresso martini which was a blend of espresso and Baileys. It was my 1st trial for that drink which turned of Amazing. Fries were sooo good and Pizza is well baked had unique taste. MUST TRY THEIR PIZZA. 🤩🤩 I would insist everyone to visit this place to try their Menu and Enjoy the ambience with exceptional service. Ambience was very joyful and uplifted the spirit. Place was well hygienic and maintained to top notch. It is very easy to reach there and parking is feasible. Overall experience is GREAT🧡

The manager Greg and his staff are outstanding. Had some questions about their services and he went above and beyond to accommodate us. Staff very friendly and prompt. Check out their 1/2 price apps Mon.-Fri. from 3pm to 6 pm.. Greg thank you for your professionalism and understanding.

For a busy Saturday night, the service was speedy and pleasant! Our server, Patrick, was so nice & steered us in the right directions with the size of appetizers portions. The drinks: spectacular! Highly recommend the Hawaiian mule and salted watermelon margaritas. The BBQ ribs were so tender and our sliders and parm truffle fries were so delicious. 😋

This location provided a better experience than the one in Ridgehill. The World Cup vibe was great! The general feel of the place was great. The food was not great. The cauliflower rice was a miss. The bits of vegetables that were in it were too chunky and uneven in the tenderness, some mushy, some hard as limestone. The pork chop was negative— it was tender, but lacked the season-to-the-bone flavor, that I’m accustomed to in a pork chop.  The sauce for it was too sweet. I felt cloyed.  The nachos were AMAZING!! I’m glad I filled up on that. The service was excellent. July was our server, she was courteous, prompt and very efficient.

Had the taco combination and whiskey + aged white cheddar w truffle fries. Both were top-notch. Our waitress was very courteous, and even kindly warned us about the spice level of the tacos. Would highly recommend.

We've gone here twice so far and enjoyed both times. The service is great, the beer is cold and is not flat (like a lot of places), the food is good and their happy hour is excellent. Yesterday we arrived during their happy hour, which we didn't know about. So it was a nice surprise. It was dinner time so they were really busy, but we added our name to the list and less than 15 minutes later we were seated. Their draft beer selection is top notch. So many good options. Our server (I think it was Johanna) was super nice and attentive. We ordered a bunch of apps and some drinks. The apps were all really good and they offer Gardein veggie chicken as an option for quite a few things, which is really awesome! We definitely would have stayed longer if we didn't have a prior obligation.

Good place to get some great food and drinks. Over 100 different beers to choose from and you can taste before settling on the one you like.
The onion tower app was absolutely amazing as well as the truffle burger.

Five stars for Yard House at American Dream Mall! I had the veggie burger and it was absolutely delightful—full of flavor, perfectly cooked, and beautifully presented. The atmosphere was lively but comfortable, making it a great place to unwind. What really stood out was the service: super friendly, fast, and attentive without being overbearing. Our server made sure everything was just right, and the food came out surprisingly quick for how busy it was. Whether you're vegetarian or not, the menu has something delicious for everyone. Highly recommend stopping by if you're visiting the mall. I’ll definitely be back!

For a restaurant in a mall, Yard House is surprisingly good. I've been here three times now, and the food has been consistently good every time. The portions are generous, and I've never had to wait too long for my food. The service has also been mostly good. The biggest downside is the noise level. The music is played extremely loud, and the sound echoes so much in the bathroom that it actually made my ears ring. I have no idea why management thinks that volume is acceptable. It's hard to understand how a restaurant can be that loud, especially when you're trying to have a conversation.

Overall though, the food and service have been reliable, and I'd come back. I just wish they'd turn the music down.

Wings were great, pizza was overcooked. That doesn’t take away from the fact this place deserves 5 stars. The atmosphere is always great and the bartenders are all very nice. Not my first time here but I’ll for sure be back! Also, great happy hour deals!

The food is delicious. Probably the best rib eye I’ve had at a non steakhouse restaurant. The atmosphere is loud and fun. Everything was great until….

I was there for my birthday, my actual birthday and although everyone else around us got a birthday song, I didn’t-even after requesting one, again. I’m not sure why this happened but it made me feel a certain way way.

We came to the restaurant on a Monday afternoon right after they opened. We were pleasantly greeted and seated immediately.  Our waiter was engaging and quick to get us our food.

For our meal, we had the Caesar salad (with chicken), a jumbo Bavarian pretzel, a mix of buffalo and barbecue boneless chicken wings and an order of classic sliders!  Appetizers for everyone!  The food was hot and delicious.

Although not busy yet, it was a great atmosphere with great food and great service.

Franklin… I want to give this place 1 star because of the first part of my review. I’m going to give it a 4 because of the second part of my review.

On 12.7.25 at around 1050, me and a horde of Jets and Dolphins fans were waiting to enter your establishment. We were anxious to sit down and relax and either get good seats at your restaurant/bar for the day or to relax for a bit before walking over to the stadium. The opening says 1100. The doors didn’t open until 1108ish. No one was sent out to let us know “something something happened, we’ll be delayed opening for just a bit and that we’re really sorry to make you stand and wait”… no apologies… no justification… just ignored it like it didn’t happen.

That being said, your staff behind the bar was really nice. One lady in particular, a tall Hispanic lady, I didn’t catch her name because she was too busy helping a crowded bar and I didn’t want to distract her, was extremely kind and her pleasant attitude was infectious. She had actually remembered me from my visit that morning when I showed up after the game. She saw me eating my pizza with ranch and demanded I get chipotle ranch because it’s better. Just kind gestures like that make all the difference.

This was my third visit to this place, and it’s been a great experience every single time. The food is always on point and the service is consistently excellent. We ordered the nachos this time and, for the first time ever, we finished the entire plate—it was that good! I’d absolutely recommend this spot to anyone looking for a solid sports bar to enjoy a fun dinner with friends or family. Totally worth it, and I’ll definitely be coming back again.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Top-Notch Experience at Yard House – Thanks to Adam!

We stopped into Yard House while visiting from out of state, and it ended up being one of the highlights of our trip! The atmosphere was lively and fun, especially with the unique view of the indoor ski slopes—it made for such a cool and memorable setting.

What really made our visit stand out, though, was our server Adam, who was without a doubt the best server in the building. From the start, he went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and taken care of. He offered samples of a few beers so we could find the perfect one, and thanks to him, we discovered the pumpkin beer, which was absolutely delicious—perfectly seasonal and super smooth.

We each ordered different types of burgers, and every single one came out exactly as we ordered—cooked to perfection and packed with flavor. Adam was attentive the entire time without being overbearing, and his friendly, genuine service made us feel like regulars even though it was our first visit.

If you're anywhere near Yard House, it’s 100% worth stopping in—and if you’re lucky enough to get Adam as your server, you’re in for an even better experience. We'll definitely be back next time we’re in town!

A little sticker shock when a glass of cheap wine is $20 (the entire bottle cost less than $15). Be careful because the little kiosk on the table was showing us Happy Hour prices but we were charged full price. Our server was awful. No personality. She didn't smile a single time or bother to apologize for bringing us the wrong order. The only thing that saved this place was the food which was good, well portioned and reasonably priced.

My boyfriend and I dined here for dinner on a Monday night. We thought it would be quiet and less packed but it was still busy. We requested to sit by the window of Big Snow and we waited about 25 minutes even though they told us it would be 30-45 minutes, which I appreciated very much. Sitting by the window was very cool. I highly recommend that. We ordered a fried cheese dish for our app, a burger and buffalo chicken pizza for dinner; and a Oreo brookie brownie and banana bread pudding for desert. None of the the dishes “wow-ed” us. It was all mediocre. Our server Jim was very friendly, polite, and attentive. Be aware that the music is very loud here. If you’re looking for a place to conversate, I would t recommend coming here. You almost have to shout at whoever you’re dining with, lol. All in all, okay/good experience.

The restaurant is spacious inside the mall and offers a beautiful view of the snowy area.
The food is very delicious, and the staff is respectful and professional.
We’ll definitely come back during happy hour — we missed it this time but would love to try it so we can order more.
Definitely worth a visit!

We came during happy hour and everything was amazing. Our server Julian was so helpful with recommendations and spice level warnings. He was attentive and was there right when you needed him. We had chicken nachos, boneless wings, and calamari. Everything tasted soo good and warm

We visited on an evening after an Giants game and the place was still "lively". It was our first time visiting while we were in town and the food was very good.  I had three taco combo...Crispy Korean Chicken, Cumin Chili Shrimp  and Beer Battered Fish. We also had the fried calamari and ginger beer.😋

I stopped at Yard House for lunch when I was visiting American Dream Mall and was happy with the food and service . Our group was originally told of a 25 minute wait time but the wait time was much quicker (about 10 minutes) . I had the Cheesesteak sandwich with Mushrooms, Peppers, Onions and White American Cheese with a side of Truffle Fries -  I would definitely eat this again !

We had a wonderful dining experience at Yard House! Our servers, Ana and Rachel, were outstanding, attentive, friendly, and efficient. They made sure we were well taken care of throughout our meal and added to the enjoyable atmosphere with their excellent service.

The only minor drawback was the initial seating experience. The host who sat us did not assist with drying the seats, which were still wet from a recent cleaning. We were given a napkin to dry them off ourselves, which was a bit unexpected.

Overall, the experience was fantastic thanks to Ana and Rachel’s stellar service. We’ll definitely be back!

We dined here last night after a long day at the Nickelodeon water park with a party of 7 (adults and kids), and it was a great experience all around. The wait time was about what you’d expect on a Saturday night—around 30–40 minutes—but they have a really convenient app that lets you track your place in line, so we were able to walk around the mall instead of standing there waiting.
The staff was friendly across the board, and our server Jim was excellent. He knew the menu inside and out, made great recommendations, and stayed on top of everything.
The food was delicious, the music created a great vibe, and everything just felt smooth and enjoyable. Honestly, the only negative was watching the Yankees lose in the last inning on TV—but that’s not their fault.
Overall, a really solid experience. We’ll definitely be back.

Updated - 4/25/25
What better way to welcome our guests, especially from Germany as first-timers, than to start at this establishment? Located inside the American Dream mall in East Rutherford, Yard House is known as the world's greatest taproom, with plenty to choose from regional breweries as well as exclusive in-house beers. Many people associate the well-known German drinking culture with the birthplace of beer.

Greeted by the staff, the host led us to one of the best tables with a front view of the ski slope where we had dinner last night. Our friends were amazed at the scenery, as some of them went this past winter to ski in Austria.

Their all-day menu offers appetizers, salads, pizza, burgers, sandwiches, tacos, and main entrees.

My partner, our visitors, and I started out to toast their visit with the House Golden Pilsner, Kona Big Wave, and Stiegl Radler. We decided on the Fried Hot Chicken Sandwich with Fries, Classic Cheeseburger, Whiskey Burger, Boneless Ancho BBQ Wings, and Chicken Bowl.

The food was solid, fresh, flavorful, and still hot when it reached the table. Good portion size, and the price was reasonable. Our server, Jim , was personable and knowledgeable, ensuring that we had everything we needed.

All boxes checked, which is why we continue to recommend this place.

Awesome meal today at Yard House! Stopped in for a lunch break while visiting the amusement park. Nice space. Friendly staff. Great food. My salmon was EXCELLENT.  GUAC was super.tasty. although I was really wanting more jalapeños.  Ms
Holly was a wonderful server as well as all the staff that supported her. Great experience.  We will be back😁😁😁😄

Experience was good and our food was good as well. The nachos app is definitely highly recommended I actually enjoyed it more than my meal! My husband had the truffle burger along with the truffle fries and he said it was delicious and very flavorful. I had the Nashville chicken sandwich but the non spicy version it was good but nothing revolutionary for me! Our waiter was very kind and attentive the only thing is their music was way too loud for my liking but that’s just personal, everything else was great!
The server was great food was on point, we were sat to the glass window facing the snow slope. Food came out fast and delicious

The service and food were excellent. The sliders were delicious. Great place to bring family and friends. The prices are moderate.  The atmosphere was great and inviting.  We sat beside the ski lift window and the view was surreal.

Yard House—A Reluctant Convert’s Confession

I’ll admit it—I’d never been to Yard House before. I usually stick to family-run spots, but sometimes places expand because they’ve nailed the key fundamentals of running a restaurant.

This Yard House is massive—upstairs and downstairs, right in the epicenter of Times Square chaos—but I was seated immediately and the server was genuinely excellent.

Two solid recommendations later, I was locked in and ready to put in work.

Started with the spicy tuna stack, which was fantastic: clean, fresh fish with just enough heat to keep things interesting.

Then came the main event: the Bleu Cheese and Bacon Burger with Truffle fries.

I am not kidding…this might be one of the best burgers I’ve had so far while here in New York.

Ridiculously decadent, piping hot (which matters more than people realize), with that perfect balance of sharp bleu cheese cutting through rich bacon and beef. The truffle fries were crispy, indulgent, and exactly the right sidekick they needed to be.

Sure, they had 18 simultaneous college basketball games playing from three time zones of teams I couldn’t pick out of a lineup…but honestly? When a burger hits this hard, I don’t care if I’m eating it inside a mosh pit!

Highly recommend…🙌🏻

Very spacious, music not too loud.

Service was very friendly and fast.

We ordered the truffle pizza and whiskey chicken wings. Both were delicious. It was our first time here but we were impressed with the food quality, ambiance and overall experience for a place so close to times square.

Five of us came for dinner on Saturday night. We had a reservation and got right in. The place gives off “sports bar” vibes, which isn’t necessarily a bad thing. I started with a 32 ounce beer in a comically gigantic glass. It was almost too hard to drink. We started with a fried cheese app, which was very good. Entrees were a few pizzas and a chicken tortilla soup. The soup was a little too creamy and also limey at the same time. The pizza was just average.  I’d come back for a beer and an appetizer but probably wouldn’t eat again.

I am a major fan of Yard House. Im from Chicago and Yard House there is my favorite restaurant! Time Square YH did not disappoint! My server Rob was on point and I would highly recommend when hanging in Time Square.  My meal "per person " was high because I drinks and desert and a appetizer!

The food menu was equally impressive in its diversity and variety.

The tuna salad was refreshing, a strong sesame oil flavour, with the tuna goes perfectly.

The orange chicken was a tad on the sweet side for me, but a nice addition. Super crunchy on the outside and moist on the inside.

The firecracker shrimp also great, only not as crunchy as I would have liked, and not spicy at all for me.

My server who I must add was new and in training (Destiny, with blonde hair and light color eyes) made us feel like family. Her spirited energy and incredible hospitality made the visit much more enjoyable. With that said, unfortunately, Twin Peaks does not offer any Gluten-Free dishes or offer Gluten-Free buns for sandwiches or burgers. However, because of the great energy and kindness of our server Destiny, we still had dinner and made it work. Thank you Twin Peaks for a great time and for training your staff to be so amazing!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had another amazing experience here! The food was delicious, the drinks were great, and the atmosphere was perfect. But Jasmine P. really made the visit stand out. She was friendly, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcomed from the moment we sat down. Great service makes a huge difference, and Jasmine definitely delivered. I’ll absolutely be coming back and asking for her again! 🔥👏🏽

I walked in and had probably the best server in the establishment, Jasmine. She recommended I have the Texas Cheesesteak and what a wonderful decision that was. I gobbled up my food so quick I thought it never came, until I realized I was resting with a full belly and a great big smile on my face. God bless Twin Peaks, and God bless this beautiful country.

I wanted to recognize the fast, attentive, and excellent service from Kilee our server. For a table of only 2, we were not only greeted and sat down quickly at our comfortable Dining table; our orders were quickly and accurately taken and delivered very fast. Kilee is the most Beautiful Twin Peaks Server at this busy location and it was a blessing to share some funny moments and hear her friendly advice. I look forward to visiting this location again especially if she will be there.

- Jordan.

Never been to Twin Peaks before, the food was amazing!! We got the brisket double stack nachos and the brisket was very flavorful. Strawberry mojito’s were very flavorful as well. Yona was an amazing waitress as well very friendly and knew so much about the menu. Will come again! (:

Venison Chili was really good a little spicy. Whatever this bacon was was pretty good as well. The waitress Octavia was one of the worst waitresses I've ever dealt with! Had no intention of ever talking to us throughout the meal and had to be tracked down so we could get the bill. SMH. All the other waitresses were interacting with their tables except her. She must think she is to good for everyone. Needless to say for a $50+ bill she got a $.70 tip for her poor service. Usually I tip 20℅ but I just couldn't bare to this time around.

It's sad to see this place slide downhill. I've been a regular customer since they first opened the doors.  My last 4 or 5 visits have been progressively less than stellar. The service and food quality seem to be in a steady decline. ••• Update••• Nov 2018 I had received one of their email flyers was a promotion for free cheso and chips you have an "I Voted" sticker. So when I got there after work there was a moderate amount of people and the place was not too busy. I showed them my sticker and ordered my free chips and queso. The queso sauce had tangy, salty, cheesy flavor flavor with a little bit of chili and onions on top. The chips were way way too salty!  I wonderef if they intentionally over-salt them to cause you to be thirsty and make you buy more drinks or beer. The grilled asparagus was not bad. It was grilled and seasoned and completely smothered in butter.  My visits to Twin Peaks have become farther and farther between. I just keep hoping this place regains some of the glamour and fun it had in the first couple years it was open but the way things are going I am not optimistic.  if my review was helpful please click the Thumbs Up Button. If you like the photos please click thumbs up on all of those as well.

The waitress was amazing, very attentive! The ambiance was great. And the food was okay. I had a cheeseburger with fries. A bit on the greasy side, but overall good. I definately like the buns! My son had the chicken tenders (very bland, I could have done better at home) and fries. Will I go back? I might give it another go.

This place seems to be a wings and burgers place. Avoiding the steak next time. They also brew their own beer and have a scotch library. Waitresses we're very friendly and place was clean. Recommended. 😎
Nice ambience, good wings..more on the bready side but still good, beautiful waitresses and only bar I know that shows the big boxing matches! We will be back for the next Big fight night!

Had a great evening out with friends. The staff this evening was absolutely amazing. Had Ashley as our server, and was not disappointed with her friendly and up beat service and attention to detail. Ashley was consistently on top of keeping drink orders filled and recommending not only appetizers but dessert and gift certificate offers as well. Her personality is warm and inviting and definitely a huge benefit for the patron. While all the staff are amazing, Ashley went above and beyond for our evening out.
Beautiful friendly staff with great food and Scenic atmosphere. Everything on the menu is delicious!

I don't normally leave reviews (good or bad), but tonight was different. I wasn't sure what to order, and my waitress knew the menu well. She recommended a dish that was perfect. She always stopped to see how I was doing and if I needed anything. It's nice to be greeted by such a great personality and someone that knows their business.
Thank you very much Ashley! Because of you, I will definitely be back. :)
Ashley made our first visit here memorable! She recommended the breaded wings, and the beers were icy cold! She was on top of everything with her service and was so much fun! We will be back!
Great food. Great service and lots to look at...  TV's that is. Lol. Excellent steak!!

Go there all the time. Went there yesterday  and had there fried chicken which is great. Service is usually great (including today.) and the girls there are friendly.
UPDATE Tonight my bud and I came and server Madison recommended the chicken Quesadillas (which were great) ,pays attention to detail great server most definitely knows her stuff.

The food is good, the company is great. I find myself here with friends about once a month or so. If you haven't try the Hangover Burger. The nachos are a great way to start the night. Ashley is typing this review and she thinks her jokes are better than ours. Still 5 star. Still coming in another week or so.

Went in on Tuesday lunch hour. ASHLEY was so amazing. Very friendly and knowledgeable on menu and recommendations. I got their punch card -- double punches on Tuesday. So after 4 lunches --- I get a free meal anytime. Great deal. SO many specials at all hours of day. I especially like the 22oz tall ice cold thick mug of Busch Light for only $3 anytime! Anyway great menu --- lots of variety - lots of specials --- and OMG the best looking ladies you have ever seen.
I've been coming to twin peaks for several years and it never gets tired. I love the lemon pepper wings and the cozy atmosphere. Ashley is friendly nice and we always look forward to having her.

Great Service, the food was great and the restaurant was clean! The atmosphere was fun and friendly. Definitely ask for Ashley as your waitress she was extremely attentive without being overwhelming and definitely made it a very enjoyable 1st visit! Will definitely be back to see Ashley again!

Overall the food is pretty decent for a chain sports bar.  It blows places like Hooters out if the water.  Beer selection is lacking, mostly domestics.  The "scenic views" are nice.  Not a place to go for wings.  Oscars is right next door and is much better.

Way better than expected! The food was great and the service was to with great scenery! Probably the best philly I've had around here in a while.  Tried something different, the fried pickle chips and they were great to. The kitchen manager (I'm guessing that's who he was ) came out and asked us how everything was witch was nice.

Excellent place to eat and kids eat for free on Saturday and Sunday. Our waitress Ashley  M was excellent and very attentive to our needs
She even brought our son another Sprite without asking. It's like she can read minds.

I'm very pleased with the service that I recieved  form Ashley she is very knowledgeable and friendly and professional! Whenever I'm here I hope she serves me. I rate Twin Peaks 5 star service and I'm totally impress with their food and services. Again thank you Ashley your awesome!

Very nice place! Awesome atmosphere. Great food and great drinks. Melanie and Anna are my favorite waitresses. They make sure that the food and drinks are served in a timely manner and accommodate my every request. Always will go back to twin peaks!
Great food! Juice burgers that I have been searching for. The services are absolutely amazing! Our server Ashely help us out a lot! She is doing a great job and we will come back!

Food was very good, temp could have been warmer I felt like it sat for a while before coming out.  Our server was great but then went off shift or something and gave us a new server which was fair at best. Drinks were left empty for quite a while before getting refills and server really never followed up with us after bringing food. Manager did thank us for trying the place and gave us some free appetizer cards as a thank you. I appreciated that and will try again when back in Omaha.

Great menu selection. The staff was very friendly and went out of their way for me. Our waitress was new, so when I asked for a vinegarette dressing for my salad, she wasn't sure if they had any. As a result, she brought me oil and vinegar as a fallback, as well as the two different dressings they had that she thought I would like. I appreciated the effort.

We are  Coloradans.... we traveled out for memorial weekend and had the pleasure of  meeting Miss lovely Ashley who took care of Our party (which is very hard to please)  I ordered the full rack of ribs that were amazing I also received my first responder discount. Ashley was a joy !
We had great fun and thank you very much to Miss Ashley!

I was with a group of 5. Our waitress was awesome, attentive n friendly..I believe Taylor was her name. The management, however, is very rude and in your face. I will not explain it on here, however if they want to reach out to me I will gladly explain the situation. As for the food, I ordered the pulled pork, it was not shredded, it was more like chopped, pieces were like 1" wide and 3" long. French fries were so skinny that you could not taste them unless you ate 4 at a time. What is sad, we used to live near  there, and ate there monthly at least, food was always real good. We moved away about 3 years ago, so this was our first time in since them. Rather disappointed in it. I believe it's main problem is management. That is the reason for 2 stars, other wise, I would have gave a 4, possible, a 5. Get rid of the managers.........

While the atmosphere of the establishment initially showed promise, the dining experience had an unfortunate significant lapses in service and culinary execution.
The evening began with a LONG wait; after being seated, it took 20 minutes and multiple inquiries with two separate staff members before our assigned waitress arrived to take our initial beverage order. This lack of service continued as we waited over 45 minutes for our main courses to arrive.
The focal point of the meal, the smokestack burger featuring smoked pork and BBQ sauce, was a notable disappointment:
The dish was sent back once since it arrived missing five essential toppings; pickled jalapenos tomatoes, pickles, cilantro and barbecue sauce. Upon its return, it remained incomplete, still missing tomatoes, pickles and cilantro.  Even after requesting the missing components on a side plate, the kitchen failed to include the cilantro.
Despite the robust ingredients mentioned, the burger was remarkably bland—lacking any discernible seasoning or depth, to the point of tasting "watery."
A memorable dining experience requires attention to detail and efficient coordination between the kitchen and staff, both of which were absent during this visit. Given the combined failure of service pacing and basic food preparation, it is difficult to recommend this establishment in its current state.
In total we spent 2 and 1/2 hours at this establishment. At no point did a manager stop by the table to ask how our visit was. Eventually, people at my table quit trying to order drinks, due to the long extended waits between ordering and receiving.

I had a mixed experience during my visit to Twin Peaks.
First, I want to recognize Kirrian for providing truly outstanding service. She was attentive, friendly, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was right. She made the experience feel special, completely different from what it could have been, and honestly is the reason we decided to stay. Her professionalism and positive attitude really stood out, and she absolutely deserves recognition—honestly, a well-deserved raise should be considered.
Unfortunately, my experience with Callie was the complete opposite. The service we received from her was very poor. There seemed to be a lack of attentiveness, and I felt uncomfortable with how we were treated. It came across as dismissive, and at times we perceived the interaction as discriminatory, which was very disappointing. There were also multiple excuses given rather than any effort to improve the situation.
Because of this, we almost decided to leave before finishing my visit.
Overall, while Kirrian made the experience worth staying for, my negative interaction significantly impacted my overall impression of the establishment.

My son and I came in for a late dinner on a Friday night.  We were quickly greeted, served drinks and appetizer and the meal was delivered in perfect timing post appetizer. Our server Samiya was friendly and made great recommendations (try the pot roast omg). I was reluctant to come this late on a Friday, but it was a great experience. Thank you!

My recent visit to Twin Peaks was unfortunately very disappointing, particularly when it came to customer service. From the start, the service felt unorganized and inattentive, especially at the bar. I understand that restaurants can get busy and staff can feel overwhelmed at times, but the level of attention we received was far below what should be expected.
Drink refills were slow and often required multiple attempts to get a bartender’s attention. Ordering food also took much longer than it reasonably should have, which added to the frustration. There was a noticeable lack of communication and urgency, making it feel like customers were not a priority during our visit.
The food was another letdown, particularly the wings. They were very underwhelming and did not meet the quality or flavor I’ve come to expect from Twin Peaks. Considering this location’s reputation and the consistency I’ve experienced at other Twin Peaks restaurants, the food here fell well short of the standard.
Overall, this was not one of the better Twin Peaks locations I’ve been to. Between the disappointing service and subpar food, the experience left a lot to be desired. I hope management takes a closer look at staffing, training, and overall execution, because this visit did not reflect the level of service or quality that Twin Peaks is known for.

Food was great as always! Ayanna was our server and took very good care of us! She made sure we had everything we needed, checked to make sure our food was to our liking and had a great personality that made us feel welcomed! I got the Chicken Ranch Sandwich, which was huge and had great flavor!
Miranda was great! Fast service and very friendly. Our food was fantastic! The kiddos loved their dessert and so did I! Definitely will be back.

Angelina most certainly lived up to her name! Very kind and attentive young lady. I would hire her to be a floor manager at my establishment in a heart-beat! She naturally and genuinely put forth great effort to ensure I had an exceptional dinning experience. She made amazing personal recommendations on menu items & paired sauces. She ensured she was engaging in friendly conversation that actually felt like she cared how my day was. Very kind, very professional! I’ve been in this industry for some time now and I was quite impressed with every part of my experience at Twin Peaks, Columbia SC. The mashed potatoes were quite honestly some of the best I’ve had at a restaurant! The chicken fried steak was terrific, everything was delicious! Cleanliness is clearly a priority at this place. The atmosphere and design is unique and puts forth a quality appearance; the service was wonderful:  the hostess was very welcoming with a kind smile on her face, the bartenders preparing drinks in exceptional time, chef knows what they’re doing, and obviously the serveress’ are rave-worthy! I’ll be back, with friends!!

Today i went to Twin Peaks for the first time in 10 years since the 2015 Waco Texas Twin Peaks brawl. It felt good to finally come back after being gone for so long. My date and my waitress was wonderful thank you for making this a wonderful time. I will definitely come back in a few weeks.

Ayanna was a very attentive sever. She was very polite and engaging and made our Group feel very comfortable with her. She explained everything about the menu and the restaurant. Extremely detailed and informative. The service went so well that we really enjoyed talking with her outside of the service. The details of every menu item was unbelievable. Reminded me of upscale restaurants in larger cities. She wasn’t just working for a tip. She shared emotions of consideration for complete satisfaction. Very High Customer Engagement and she did not have to be so nice and detailed. I am a true fan of her and I am grateful for the experience that she shared.

Stopped by on my way through SC and wow; 10/10 service, beer was ice cold, food was killer! BUT most of all gotta give it to Bree, super helpful and friendly. Go there.Ask for her.You won't have a better experience elsewhere!

Had dinner at the bar. Neveah was amazing. Not only was she gorgeous, cute, and flirty, which is assumed to be a given at a place like Twin Peaks, she was also funny, real, and genuinely intelligent. Her service was above and beyond. Another server dropped my food off (grilled salmon, cooked perfectly) but neglected silverware, and when I asked Neveah for silverware she acted like she ran over my dog. Immediately got me silverware, and I had to reassure her she wasn't at fault for the minute or two I wasn't able to eat. She was fantastic, and I'll be returning just in the hopes of being served by her again. Especially when she told me it was her first shift there, I would have never guessed.

5 stars, will be returning, she was everything and more a person could want in a bartender, let alone one in such a niche role as a "girl" at Twin Peaks.

The Trophy trout was exceptional—perfectly cooked with a delicate, flaky texture and a clean, fresh flavor. The light char from the grill added depth without overpowering the fish.The presentation was clean and appetizing, showing real attention to detail.

Service Experience

The service elevated the entire meal. My waiter- Sarah was outstanding, attentive without being intrusive and genuinely welcoming from start to finish.

Overall Impression

This lunch at Twin Peaks delivered on all fronts—flavor, balance, and hospitality.

First impression will be my last impression.  Food was really good once we got it. Went in before 2 and didn't get food until we had been there almost am hour and a half.  Waitress brought out boneless 6 piece chicken wings for adults for a 4 yr old so we got charged almost $13 for a child to eat. Not many customers in the restaurant so really no reason for service to be so slow or poor.  The 3 piece chicken strips on the kids menu had more to it than the 6 piece boneless wings served my granddaughter. Waitress was attempting to be helpful with the wings because she was asked for chicken nuggets but we should have been told what she was talking about would cost as much as it did. The child's menu chicken strips only cost $5. When an appetizer was ordered the waitress was told how to divide the check for the table. When ready to go she asked how to divide the check twice before going to get the two checks ready and still messed it up.  Then when the manager was spoken to she said she would go correct it but she never stopped by the table to speak to anyone to make sure things were taken care of correctly, not sure if the waitress was spoken to.  Instead of making any more complaints we paid the mixed up checks and left.  Personally, with the minimum amount of people that were in the restaurant(maybe 20 other people) we received very poor service and I have no desire to visit the restaurant again.

i went here w my friends for the first time and it was so good!! zariah was super nice to all of us😊 i ordered a borger and sandae. i like the brownie sooo bad ( i dont really like chocolate things BUT THIS ONE). i would recommend it!!

We have been coming here for a long time. Erica was our server and she was by far the best experience we’ve ever had here. She was personable, she remembered everything, she was thoughtful, and attentive. I won’t speak on specific past experiences, but there is a huge difference in this visit compared to before, by far. The host mentioned specials at the beginning of our visit when she sat us and food/beer came out quickly. Also, the manager (we believe) who works here, she has blonde hair we believe, has been fantastic every time. She’s constantly running food, tending to customers, and is always on the floor. She deserves a raise. My wife and I have worked in management for most of our careers, and we know how hospitality can be. She is truly an asset to your team. We will be back.

It's so loud in there you can't even hear the person next to you. The food was just ok. My husband had the ribeye medium rare and all you could taste was the burnt char on the outside, the mash potatoes had no flavor. My daughter had the lobster roll but. She said it was great. I had the philly cheesesteak it was ok, didnt have very many peppers or onions. Not much flavor, very greasy.

I had an amazing experience!!  Jocelyn was my server and she was so helpful with giving suggestions on what to order (I got the quesobirria tacos). She was very attentive and friendly!  The food and drinks were great and I had an amazing experience.  I will definitely be returning

I had an absolute amazing time tonight. The food was amazing got the sampler plate for an appetizer with the tenders tossed in their Thai chili sauce as a suggestion from our server Nevaeh. I also got the quesabirria tacos which were delicious. Nevaeh was absolutely amazing, she was so attentive and sweet. Highly recommend stopping in. Will definitely be back !!

Jocelyn has a vibrant energy to be around! She took amazing care of us. She knew what we needed before we had to ask. Great conversationalist. She made our experience at Twin Peaks one hell of an experience. The food here is also top notch! All around great service!

Layla, my server, was very attentive, personable, and provided excellent service. She made sure I never had to wait and consistently checked in to ensure I had everything I needed. Her friendly attitude and attention to detail made the experience even better.

SARAH is a 15/10! She was very attentive, knew the menu really well and she made the experience a lot of fun. Genuinely such a super nice person. Listen, I wouldn’t get the chicken chipotle dish. It was super dry (we didn’t say anything; I believe they would’ve corrected it if we had though), but the fried jalapeños were legit and the pot roast was super yummy. The Ghirardelli dessert was good too! Solid dinner. She recommended the extra gravy for the pot roast and it was delicious.

Our waitress, Emily, was an outstanding waitress. She was friendly and attentive to two senior citizens. It was our first visit so she filled us in on some interesting information about the restaurant. She helped to make the visit a pleasant memory.  We wish her success now and in any of her future endeavors.

I am a returning customer, and I have to say that this visit was a great experience just like before.

I was quickly greeted at the door by my server, Chantelle, Who escorted me to my table and quickly gave me information about today’s specials and recommendations

Chantelle informed me that she was new to the Twin Peaks family and was going to provide me great service.

My visit was not during a peak time so my server only had a limited number of tables. She was very attentive to not only the large table that she was serving, but also mine that was a single.

In my opinion, Chantelle is a great representative to the twin Peaks family, and definitely a good ambassador to the brand.

I will definitely return in the future and I hope I am lucky enough to be here while Chantelle is working. As a former server in the food industry from back in the day, I definitely get her five stars for her customer service and brand knowledge.

First I want to say I really enjoyed the atmosphere and vibes of the place. The decor is cute and the bar is HUGE! I just didnt have that great of a food experience but I am willing to try again.

We were greeted at the bar super quickly and the bar tenders were very kind. I love that when you get a draft they give you a frozen glass! Nothing better than an ICE cold cider and having a frozen glass keeps it perfect. The prices of the tall cider was great too!

Now for the food.... we got the Triple Play Dip with Tortilla chips. The chips were good but a little too salty for me. The dips were not bad im just not a fan of cilantro and they put a good bit in all of the choices but my boyfriend really liked the dips. Then we got the Brisket Chili. I totally believe that they only put a cup of chili in the bowl because the bowls were HALF filled and they had hardly any brisket in them and they charge $2 more.... All I could taste was the regular beef and the flavor was not that great. I had really high hopes for it since I love brisket but I was disappointed at the portion size as well as the flavor.

I am willing to go back and try their wings because they do have smoked and grilled wings that looked gluten free and they looked pretty good. Plus its a good drinking bar.

All in all ill be back definitely for the drink prices but possibly the food. Everyone deserves a second chance.

Tatum & Delanie were amazing! Always attentive and friendly, and my glass was never empty! Food and service was outstanding! 6 out of 5 stars for them! Also, Kyanne is a phenomenal person! I love coming here when I visit for vacation!! ❤️

We rolled in today (Saturday) with no reservation or heads up, after a memorial service for a close friend. When I say “we,” I mean about 20 of us. Eek! They were still so welcoming, Aubrey’s service was great, the food was speedy, and the tall ice cold beers were glorious…picture a lava lamp of beer with beer glaciers floating to the surface—perfect for a toast in honor of our friend Dave. Thank you!

The last time I was here was over a year ago. At that time, the staff was good and the place was clean. This recent visit was completely different. I ordered the ribs meal $18.99. The ribs were totally overcooked and dry. It was like eating charcoal. It came with a tiny cup of mac and cheese and coleslaw. The staff at the bar seemed like they didn't really wanna be there. The only highlight were the 29° beers that were $6.99 for a 20 ounce mug. They were ice cold and had an okay beer selection. They had more options before. The bar wasn't very clean and the bathrooms were filthy with broken toilets. I thought of complaining, but honestly after reading the room, I don't think anyone would've cared. They have numerous tv's for games which is nice, but the speakers were so loud that I could barely hear the group of people I was with. I can see why this franchise is filing for bankruptcy and closing locations. I might go back in a year  just for the cold beers, if they are still open.

Just had a great evening enjoying the bar. Our servers Tatum, Mercedes, and Ella treated my wife and I to an evening of fine food and good times. 100% will be back to do it again! Can’t wait, see ya next time.

In today’s economy getting all this for under $20 is insane.  The food is awesome and the service is spectacular.  Chantelle was an awesome sever.  All of the staff here is superb! Thank goodness for happy hour!
Our server ally was phenomenal!! We needed nothing as she already had it on the table! Highly recommend this place! She was training Emily so I expect she’ll be awesome too!

[This is NOT an Artificial Intelligence AI generated review but a real world Chuck Whigham review.]

I was recommended to this location by our great customer and I went here for dinner. Karsyn was my server and for my beverage I ordered water, no ice, and four lemons. For my entree, I ordered the Chargrilled Salmon with no rice and I substituted it with a Caesar Salad and Broccoli as my other side. Karsyn was very welcoming, friendly, courteous, and professional. It was football Sunday and they were rather busy. She got my "Dine In" order quickly prepared and processed. The Salmon was fresh, hot, and delicious and so was the Caesar Salad and Broccoli.

Patrons continued to roll in wearing their favorite team and players football jersey. The restaurant is rather large but well managed and they "Keep It Moving." The bathrooms are clean and maintained and the parking lot free of debris. This was my second time visiting Twin Peaks and my first time was in North Carolina which was also a great experience. I witnessed zero riffraff or transients in the eateries parking lot and I will definitely be returning to this location when I am in the area.
Sarah was our server!! She was super nice, her service was great! And they took a picture with my friend for her birthday. Had a super fun time!

Once again what a great experience. I know it's a chain and now my buddy Jordan and Dawson are in on the review. We all give this twin peaks a A tear rating. The food was good and the beer was great but what made this place was this girl Aubrey. Great smile laughed with us and she is a foodie so it just made the experience awsome. Come see her and I promise if you ask for her she will treat you great.

We had Sarah as a server, she was amazing! Super personable and sweet. Great server, we didn’t have to ask for a refill on our drinks once. Food was delicious and worth every penny spent! We will definitely be back!

This review is for our August 2026 visit.
We were on a time crunch, and our server was very attentive to our need.  We ordered loaded fries and a pepperoni flatbread.  Our drinks were refilled often, and our food was delivered quickly.  Everything was delicious, hot and fresh.  ALLY B. brought us boxes and the check so we could keep on schedule.   Thank you ALLY!

5/5 – Absolutely the best experience I’ve had at Twin Peaks, all thanks to Chantelle.
From the second she walked up to our table with that genuine smile and excellent attitude, the night was already won. Chantelle is the kind of server who makes the whole place feel warmer. She remembered our drinks after the first round, timed the food perfectly so nothing sat, and somehow kept every table in her section happy without ever looking rushed. That takes real skill and pure professionalism.
She was attentive without hovering, funny without forcing it, and made excellent recommendations that actually matched what we were in the mood for. The food was solid (as expected), the atmosphere was lively, but Chantelle was the reason we stayed longer and left happier than when we walked in.
If you’re heading to Twin Peaks, ask for Chantelle. She’s the gold standard. Exceptional service, great energy, and the kind of hospitality that turns a regular night out into something you’ll actually talk about later. Can’t wait to go back.

What really made our visit stand out was our server, Aubrey. She was awesome! From the moment we sat down, she was incredibly welcoming, attentive, and energetic. Even though the restaurant was buzzing, she made sure our drinks were always refilled and checked in on us at the perfect times. Excellent hospitality is hard to come by these days, but Aubrey nailed it.
Alexa, was a terrific waitress with a sparkling and bubbly personality. We always love coming here. Thank you for helping to make this a memorable day for my son’s 16th birthday.

Had an amazing service from Aquilla! She was attentive,friendly and had a warm personality. We were on a road trip from Toronto and glad we came over before the Pirates game. Highly recommend in the future!
First time at the Robinson location and Emily was the 5 star waitress that served us. Location, atmosphere, food, service, everything was 5 stars. Will come again when I'm in the area!

Viv and Liz are hands down the BEST bartenders at Twin Peaks in Columbia — and that’s coming from a regular. I’ve been here plenty of times, and every time I sit with them, they set the tone. The energy is always right, they’re welcoming, funny, and just genuinely good people.

Drinks are always on point and come out fast, no matter how busy it gets. And even when the bar is packed, they stay locked in and make sure you’re taken care of like you’re the only one there.

What really separates them is the attention to detail. They make sure my food is always right, check in consistently, and I never have to ask for anything — they’re already on it. Whether it’s a refill, napkins, or anything else, they’re watching and bringing it before you even think about it. That level of service is rare.

Nothing feels forced with them — it’s real, smooth, and makes the whole experience better every time. That’s exactly why I keep coming back.

If you’re going to Twin Peaks, do yourself a favor and sit with Viv and Liz. That’s the move every time — you won’t regret it.

The TV on our table and on the tables around me were caked with old residue hopefully not bodily residue. The napkin my silverware came in, appeared very dirty, and even had a hair in it. And upon inspection of the silverware, it was also dirty. My suggestion is for you to use soda water and wipe the silverware prior to wrapping it. It will take off any grime left from the dish washer. I would also insure your dishwasher is cleaning out the tank multiple times throughout the shift. It's a cool place to hang out, but unfortunately they apparently need to get back to basics on cleanliness.

I walked into this place expecting mountains — actual geography, snow-capped, majestic, the kind of thing Lewis and Clark might have paused to sketch — and instead found myself in a dim wood-paneled lodge full of flannel and antlers, utterly baffled about what twin peaks this establishment was named after, because I scanned the horizon through every window and did not see a single peak, twin or otherwise, just a parking lot and a Runza across the street. And yet the confusion didn’t stop there, because every single woman working the floor appeared to be engaged in some kind of silent, unspoken competition to see who could wear the tightest uniform and the strongest buttons, a phenomenon I found scientifically fascinating and repeatedly failed to understand, the way a golden retriever fails to understand a card trick. I just sat there, watching, nodding slowly, convinced I was missing some crucial piece of Nebraska cultural context that no one was willing to explain to me.

The beer was cold, the service was good, the golf occupied what appeared to be every television manufactured since 1997, and the place was undeniably entertaining. But then came the Guinness, and somewhere an Irish grandmother quietly lowered her head in disappointment. Guinness is not meant to arrive imprisoned in a squat little beer mug that makes it look like a sample at a state fair. It deserves a proper imperial pint glass with enough room for that magnificent creamy head to settle into liquid perfection. Serving it any other way feels like hanging the Mona Lisa in a motel laundry room. It’s a small detail, but details matter when you’re charging people for one of the world’s great beers.

So I’m leaving with four stars instead of five. I still don’t know what twin peaks they’re referring to, I remain hopelessly confused by the wardrobe strategy, and I had a perfectly entertaining afternoon. But if you’re going to serve Guinness, let it be Guinness. Until then, this remains one of the most enjoyable places in Omaha to be delightfully bewildered.

Brindle Room
647 East 11th. St.
New York, NY 10009

Sebastian Burger & Fries

As I was passing by, I spotted their sidewalk billboard, which mentioned Guy Fieri highly praising their burgers.  I was instantly convinced right then and there to give this bar a try!

This burger was topped with American cheese and caramelized onions on a soft bun.  The medium cooked patty is made with prime aged beef.

As a bonus, french fries are also included with the burger.

Guy Fieri was definitely right about this perfectly compacted sandwich that I cleared down to the last bite.

#brindleroom #sebastianburger #sebastianburgerandfries #brindleroomnyc #guyfieri #eastvillage

It is the brasserie / dive bar / bistro / speak easy that you were always looking to make your local joint. The decor screams “if you know you know” without the pretentiousness. We had Sebastian burgers with and without bacon…and this is key…we were not asked how we wanted it cooked…great sign. The burger was unctuous with delicious flavor that was reminiscent of aged steak. The burger was perfectly cooked and though I normally prefer thinner patties this thick patty was done perfectly and had the perfect texture all the way through. The KGB sauce was great the twice cooked fries were excellent and the decor fits the menu. There are places you go to once to say you went and there are places that you keep returning to over and over…Brindle Room is the latter.

Mouth watering, succulent, cooked to perfection burger. I cannot express to you how you are not checking out this dive and dine. Eloquently placed in the lower Eastside, Nancy Pelosi should run and try. This stuff, the staff, is dapper, I can’t explain. From the hot sauce, the truffle fries, all is not in vein. I do ordain to visit so glad, this Brindle Burger was the juiciest pleasure I ever had.
The best burger in the city! I was here YEARS ago and was curious if it would still be as good as I remember. Such good food! The wings are fire too.

The burger was fine, but definitely not the best not in the world, not in New York, and probably not even in the neighborhood. The burger was served rare, which isn’t my favorite doneness. I assumed they had their standard as no one asked me how I wanted it cooked. Now I a bit regret saying it was fine instead of sharing my honest opinion to the staff.
Very tasty burger - prices are reasonable for crazy NYC standards and the service was quick and nice. Want to go back
The burger is average , but not the best burger in New York. The fries is good. Chicken wings is delicious.

Not enough good things can be said about this east village institution. Brindle Room’s menu is kept simple because when you do a burger so right, why do anything else. I’m salivating once again just thinking of it.

This cozy laid back joint is perfect for a bite and cocktail. A great place to relax.

Burger was good, above average but not the best. The problem was how filthy and rundown the interior is. We sat in a booth, a the little wall ledge next to booth had a heavy layer of grease and dust. I ran my napkin over a few inches of the ledge- see napkin pic. It was almost hard to sit inside because the was so many flies, they were hard to ignore. Windows were filthy and pile of junk by bathroom. I’m surprised for a place that seems to be well liked it’s not taken care of- dirty is just unacceptable.

Came in last week, good music, food was great, service was even better. Chloe was nice and quick and Natalie’s drinks were the cherry on top. I would recommend a reservation, especially on Friday nights

Went there today, a Tuesday afternoon. Literally the only duo in the restaurant but that did not take away from the experience. Service was friendly without being intrusive. The menu is brief and to the point. The food came out exactly as ordered. And wow! What a burger! Fancy without being bougie, well put together without being sloppy, ingredients and preparation clearly show that whomever designed/made this knows what they're doing and as importantly cares about what they're doing. Fries are spot on. Crunchy without being dry and salted to perfection. Do yourself a favor and go here!

Maybe the best burger in the city right now! Great spot to impress a date (who loves a good burger, interesting cocktails and a vibe)

We also loved the Brussel sprouts with pumpkin seed tahini and their chicken schnitzel. Definitely will be back soon for that burger!

Not worth its weight as a $30 burger.

It’s such a cute place I highly recommend coming to grab a bite and some drinks to catch up with friends

The wings are great Not your usual pub/restaurant fare but juicy plump wings worthy of being their own entree. But it's the burger that brings it all together. Classic cheeseburger with carmelized onions that is second to none. Enjoy a cold beverage, wings and a burger and all will seem ok in your world.

Overall, great atmosphere for enjoying great food and drinks. The burger was cooked to perfection, perfect amount of pink. Great spot to socialize and meet new friends as well. Stop worth stop by.

I recently had one of the most memorable nights out I have experienced in a long time at this spot and it has completely convinced me to return to Greenpoint for more evenings out very soon. If you are planning a visit to this bar the most important logistical detail to keep in mind is that they are strictly a cash only bar. While there is an ATM available inside I would highly recommend bringing cash with you to avoid any extra fees or wait times at the machine. The atmosphere here is truly exceptional and was easily the highlight of my visit. It was filled with such an eclectic and interesting crowd where everyone was dressed in their own unique and creative style which made for incredible people watching and a vibrant energy. Despite the place being quite busy the service remained top tier throughout the night. The waitresses were incredibly nice and attentive making sure we were well taken care of without ever feeling rushed. It is rare to find a place that balances such a cool underground aesthetic with genuinely friendly and professional hospitality. I highly recommend checking this spot out if you want a night that feels authentic and full of character. This was easily one of my favorite experiences in the neighborhood and I am already looking forward to my next visit to see what kind of crowd it draws next time.

That same day, I messaged the clinic to ask for clarification about why I had to pay. I believe that before any procedures are done, the front desk should clearly explain what will be performed and what the expected costs or co-pays will be—especially for first-time patients. Only then was I told that while they accept TRICARE, they are not in network. This should have been clearly explained beforehand because not everyone understands the difference, including me.

Now I have received another bill in the mail for $207, which is very frustrating and unexpected. I wish the clinic had been more transparent about costs and insurance coverage from the beginning

I made my first appointment with Gentle Care based on the reviews. I really wanted to like this dentistry but it didn’t work out. There’s a small parking lot available for parking which is great. The business itself is clean and maintained. There’s even a corner where children can go play video games while they wait which is great. All the dental technicians are very polite. Good vibes so far.

When I arrived the receptionist was attentive. Check in as a first time patient was easy. I was let in and guided to the back where x rays were taken. So this is the second time I’ve encountered a dentist with those X-ray machines where you stand and it takes a picture of your whole mouth at once. They’re not really good for anything because the dentist still has to take X-rays the ‘normal’ way in the chair, which is what I immediately thought when I saw the machine.

After the standing X-ray machine the dentist did come in and take pictures of my teeth, okay that was great. Asked me if I had a mouth guard bc I grind my teeth at night. I said yes. We had a short conversation about that and some fillings I needed, then the dentist was gone and left me with the technicians to talk about price and other things. One of the technicians explained that if I switched to a better insurance at my work, I could get the better fillings. Okay cool, I planned on doing that.

But then when I asked why I wasn’t getting the actual tartar removal and was just getting the tooth polish as a cleaning, the technician said that in order to get the actual tartar removal I’d need to get the other sets of X-rays in the chair which I would have to pay out of pocket for. So that’s where things went south. Why didn’t they just do the regular sets of in-chair X-rays? I don’t know. Why does the dentist even have a standing X-ray machine if they need to do the in chair X-rays anyway? I don’t know. Why would I need to pay out pocket when my insurance pays for a cleaning and X-rays? I don’t know. Why wasn’t the dentist there explaining things to me instead of the technician? I don’t know.

So I said forget it and bounced. I called my insurance and asked if tartar removal was included in my cleaning, they said yes, that I don’t need to pay out of pocket. So this whole story of me needing to pay for other sets of X-rays when the dentist could have just taken those to begin with and complete my tartar removal was ridiculous. Had he done that, I would have stayed on as a client and gotten my work done with him.

Overall I liked the vibe of the dentistry, the dentist had good manners, but the time he spent with me as a possible steady patient was short in comparison to almost every other dentistry I’ve been to. I spent more time with the techs than the actual dentist. Also, that whole needing to pay for extra X-rays for a tooth tartar scraping was unnecessary. I took time off work to come here and get my exam and cleaning. Not getting the service I expected when I literally took off work for it is not acceptable. I won’t be coming back.
